vocabHinglish4.trick: Memory Trick: 'Institute' (संस्था) जैसे Parliament, RBI या Supreme Court के स्तर पर होने वाला काम Institutional है!

vocabHinglish4.hinglish: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
vocabHinglish4.trick: Memory Trick: 'Account' (हिसाब) + 'Ability' = जनता के सामने हर काम का हिसाब देने की ज़िम्मेदारी!

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q1 • Central Inference & Passage Core
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
options: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the...
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fu' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Global climate talks must shut door on fossil' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'Global climate talks must shut door on fossil' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the..." (Hinglish Arth: अंताल्या शिखर सम्मेलन के टूटने से जलवायु कूटनीति में विश्वास का संकट गहरा गया है, जिससे बातचीत प्रक्रिया में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही पहले से कहीं अधिक जरूरी हो गई है।)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations." (Hinglish Arth: उनका तर्क है कि एक बार जब कंपनियों को पहुंच मिल जाती है, तो यह निगरानी करना बेहद मुश्किल हो जाता है कि वे बातचीत को प्रभावित करने के लिए इसका उपयोग कैसे करते हैं।)

hinglishTracks.en: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अंताल्या शिखर सम्मेलन के टूटने से जलवायु कूटनीति में विश्वास का संकट गहरा गया है, जिससे बातचीत प्रक्रिया में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही पहले से कहीं अधिक जरूरी हो गई है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या, तुर्किये में संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन की विफलता, इसके केंद्रीय राजनीतिक बयान पर सहमत होने में, जीवाश्म ईंधन और जलवायु कार्रवाई के अन्य प्रमुख प्रश्नों पर अपने मतभेदों को पाटने में असमर्थ देशों ने, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु सहयोग की नाजुकता को उजागर किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसे इस बात की भी जांच तेज करनी चाहिए कि जलवायु वार्ताओं तक किसे पहुंच मिलती है, वे किसके हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और कौन से सुरक्षा उपाय निर्णयों को जनता के प्रति जवाबदेह बनाए रखते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — तुर्किये शिखर सम्मेलन एक व्यापक बयान पर सहमति के बिना समाप्त हो गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — संयुक्त राष्ट्र के जलवायु प्रमुख साइमन स्टिल ने कहा कि वह कई लोगों की "गहरी निराशा" को साझा करते हैं कि सम्मेलन एक ऐसे बयान पर आम सहमति तक पहुंचने में असमर्थ था जो आम तौर पर सभी देशों को नीति संकेत भेजता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि कुछ अलग-अलग बातचीत के निर्णयों पर सहमति बनी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — फिर भी, राजनीतिक सहमति का अभाव एक गंभीर झटका था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ब्रेकडाउन से यह नहीं पता चलता कि जीवाश्म ईंधन की पैरवी गतिरोध का कारण बनी।।

hinglishTracks.en: But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन यह प्रक्रिया की विश्वसनीयता के बारे में एक अलग प्रश्न को और अधिक जरूरी बना देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक मंच जो सरकारों से वैश्विक जनहित में निर्णय लेने के लिए कहता है, उसे इस बारे में पारदर्शी होना चाहिए कि उन निर्णयों को कौन आकार देना चाहता है, वे किन हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और संघर्षों का प्रबंधन कैसे किया जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हर साल होने वाली अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु वार्ता में अभी भी जीवाश्म ईंधन कंपनियों और राज्य के स्वामित्व वाले ऊर्जा व्यवसायों सहित शक्तिशाली वाणिज्यिक हितों से जुड़े हितों के टकराव की पहचान करने और प्रबंधित करने के लिए एक व्यापक, लागू करने योग्य प्रणाली का अभाव है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या सम्मेलन ने रेखांकित किया है कि यह अंतर क्यों मायने रखता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जीवाश्म ईंधन उद्योग का पानी को गंदा करने का रिकॉर्ड अच्छी तरह से प्रलेखित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जेफ्री सुप्रान और नाओमी ओरेस्केस द्वारा 2017 के एक अध्ययन में 1977 और 2014 के बीच 187 एक्सॉनमोबिल संचार की तुलना की गई, जिसमें आंतरिक दस्तावेज़, वैज्ञानिक प्रकाशन और भुगतान किए गए समाचार पत्र विज्ञापन शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसमें पाया गया कि जैसे-जैसे कंपनी के संचार अधिक सार्वजनिक होते गए, उन्होंने जलवायु विज्ञान के बारे में संदेह व्यक्त करना शुरू कर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — शोधकर्ताओं ने निष्कर्ष निकाला कि एक्सॉनमोबिल ने अपने विज्ञापनों में इसके बारे में संदेह को बढ़ावा देते हुए जलवायु विज्ञान में योगदान दिया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक उद्योग टीम ने अमेरिकी पेट्रोलियम संस्थान के मुख्यालय में वैश्विक जलवायु विज्ञान संचार योजना के 1998 के मसौदे पर चर्चा की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — योजना का घोषित लक्ष्य अमेरिकी जनता के बहुमत को यह विश्वास दिलाना था कि जलवायु विज्ञान में महत्वपूर्ण अनिश्चितताएँ बनी हुई हैं और नीति निर्माताओं के बीच सवाल खड़े करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह इतिहास मायने रखता है क्योंकि तेल, गैस और कोयले में बड़े निवेश वाली कंपनियों की वित्तीय हिस्सेदारी होती है कि उन ईंधनों को कितनी जल्दी चरणबद्ध किया जाता है, किन प्रौद्योगिकियों को समर्थन मिलता है और संक्रमण की लागत कैसे वितरित की जाती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन में प्रत्येक कंपनी का प्रतिनिधि प्रगति में बाधा डालने के लिए मौजूद है, या यह कि उपस्थिति किसी निर्णय पर प्रभाव साबित करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि, इसका मतलब यह है कि व्यावसायिक हितों को दिखाई देने की आवश्यकता है और प्रक्रिया को अनुचित प्रभाव को रोकने के लिए नियमों की आवश्यकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The scale of corporate participation in Antalya brings the issue into sharper focus.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या में कॉर्पोरेट भागीदारी का पैमाना इस मुद्दे को और अधिक ध्यान में लाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: An analysis by a coalition of non-profits identified 103 major polluter groups with delegations at the summit, including fossil fuel businesses, financiers and companies from other high-emitting sectors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — गैर-लाभकारी गठबंधन के एक विश्लेषण ने शिखर सम्मेलन में प्रतिनिधिमंडलों के साथ 103 प्रमुख प्रदूषक समूहों की पहचान की, जिनमें जीवाश्म ईंधन व्यवसाय, फाइनेंसर और अन्य उच्च उत्सर्जन क्षेत्रों की कंपनियां शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It also identified 30 banks whose fossil fuel financing between 2021 and 2025 amounted to more than $2.2 trillion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसने 30 बैंकों की भी पहचान की, जिनका 2021 और 2025 के बीच जीवाश्म ईंधन वित्तपोषण 2.2 ट्रिलियन डॉलर से अधिक था।।

hinglishTracks.en: These are the coalition’s classifications, not official UN figures.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ये गठबंधन के वर्गीकरण हैं, संयुक्त राष्ट्र के आधिकारिक आंकड़े नहीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: They do not establish that the companies or banks influenced the negotiations.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:41:40 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation. It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public. The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement. UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations. Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though. Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback. The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse. But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process. A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed. The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses. The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters. The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented. A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials. It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science. The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials. An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters. The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers. This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed. That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision. It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence. The scale of corporate participation in Antalya brings the issue into sharper focus. An analysis by a coalition of non-profits identified 103 major polluter groups with delegations at the summit, including fossil fuel businesses, financiers and companies from other high-emitting sectors. It also identified 30 banks whose fossil fuel financing between 2021 and 2025 amounted to more than $2.2 trillion. These are the coalition’s classifications, not official UN figures. They do not establish that the companies or banks influenced the negotiations. But they show the scale of commercial interests present at a conference whose purpose is to limit global warming.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Lien Vandamme of the Center for International Environmental Law says the problem goes beyond the number of corporate participants. Although the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) has introduced limited disclosure requirements, she argues that it still lacks a policy to curb corporate influence. “There is currently no policy to curb corporate influence within the UNFCCC process, and this is a fundamental problem,” she says. Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fu' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Global climate talks must shut door on fossil' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Global climate talks must shut door on fossil' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the..." (Hinglish Arth: अंताल्या शिखर सम्मेलन के टूटने से जलवायु कूटनीति में विश्वास का संकट गहरा गया है, जिससे बातचीत प्रक्रिया में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही पहले से कहीं अधिक जरूरी हो गई है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations." (Hinglish Arth: उनका तर्क है कि एक बार जब कंपनियों को पहुंच मिल जाती है, तो यह निगरानी करना बेहद मुश्किल हो जाता है कि वे बातचीत को प्रभावित करने के लिए इसका उपयोग कैसे करते हैं।)

articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Why is the Mine Ban Treaty facing a crisis? Why are more civilians falling victim to landmines? Are countries turning away from the landmine ban?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Landmines and explosive remnants of war (ERW, meaning unexploded or abandoned ordnance) killed or injured more people in 2025 than in any year since 2020, according to the 28th annual Landmine Monitor report, which was released on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) by the International Campaign to Ban Landmines (ICBL). Its findings come as the Mine Ban Treaty, which bans antipersonnel mines, has seen its first-ever withdrawals.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The treaty came into force on March 1, 1999, after a campaign that won the ICBL the Nobel Peace Prize in 1997. Countries that join must stop the use, stockpiling, production, and transfer of antipersonnel mines. They must destroy their stockpiles within four years and clear mines in areas they control within 10 years. A total of 162 countries are now bound by the treaty, while 35 remain outside it.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसमें शामिल होने वाले देशों को एंटीपर्सनेल खानों के उपयोग, भंडारण, उत्पादन और हस्तांतरण को रोकना होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Production' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Production' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: They must destroy their stockpiles within four years and clear mines in areas they control within 10 years.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्हें चार साल के भीतर अपने भंडार को नष्ट करना होगा और 10 साल के भीतर अपने नियंत्रण वाले क्षेत्रों में खदानों को साफ़ करना होगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: A total of 162 countries are now bound by the treaty, while 35 remain outside it.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अब कुल 162 देश इस संधि से बंधे हैं, जबकि 35 देश इससे बाहर हैं।।

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Why are landmine casualties rising as the global ban comes under threat? | Explained

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:11:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Why is the Mine Ban Treaty facing a crisis? Why are more civilians falling victim to landmines? Are countries turning away from the landmine ban?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Landmines and explosive remnants of war (ERW, meaning unexploded or abandoned ordnance) killed or injured more people in 2025 than in any year since 2020, according to the 28th annual Landmine Monitor report, which was released on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) by the International Campaign to Ban Landmines (ICBL). Its findings come as the Mine Ban Treaty, which bans antipersonnel mines, has seen its first-ever withdrawals.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The treaty came into force on March 1, 1999, after a campaign that won the ICBL the Nobel Peace Prize in 1997. Countries that join must stop the use, stockpiling, production, and transfer of antipersonnel mines. They must destroy their stockpiles within four years and clear mines in areas they control within 10 years. A total of 162 countries are now bound by the treaty, while 35 remain outside it.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Why are landmine casualties rising as the global ban comes under threat? | Explained", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Why is the Mine Ban Treaty facing a crisis?.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Why are landmine casualties rising as the global' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Why are landmine casualties rising as the glo' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Why are landmine casualties rising as the glo' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Why is the Mine Ban Treaty facing a crisis?." (Hinglish Arth: खदान प्रतिबंध संधि क्यों संकट का सामना कर रही है?)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Why are landmine casualties rising as the global ban comes under threat? | Explained"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. A total of 162 countries are now bound by the treaty, while 35 remain outside it.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "A total of 162 countries are now bound by the treaty, while 35 remain outside it." (Hinglish Arth: अब कुल 162 देश इस संधि से बंधे हैं, जबकि 35 देश इससे बाहर हैं।)

articles.title: India-Nepal joint military exercise begins in Rupandehi
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A joint military training exercise between Nepal and India, focusing on disaster management, forest welfare and humanitarian assistance, commenced on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). The 20th edition of the training exercise, “Abhyas Suryakiran”, began at Nepal Army Battle School in Saljhandi, Rupandehi district, according to a press release issued by the Nepal Army. The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8. During the exercise, the military personnel of the two countries will exchange theoretical and practical aspects as well as special experiences relating to disaster management, forest warfare and humanitarian assistance, according to the Nepal Army. The 19th edition of the joint military exercise was held in Uttarakhand’s Pithoragarh last year.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Nepal Army believes such types of military exercises will further deepen friendly military relations between the two countries and also enhance professional skills and understanding between the soldiers of the two countries, the press release said.

1. Core Context & Background: The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A joint military training exercise between Nepal and India, focusing on disaster management, forest welfare and humanitarian assistance, commenced on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). The 20th edition of the training exercise, “Abhyas Suryakiran”, began at Nepal Army Battle School in Saljhandi, Rupandehi district, according to a press release issued by the Nepal Army. The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8. During the exercise, the military personnel of the two countries will exchange theoretical and practical aspects as well as special experiences relating to disaster management, forest warfare and humanitarian assistance, according to the Nepal Army. The 19th edition of the joint military exercise was held in Uttarakhand’s Pithoragarh last year.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Nepal Army believes such types of military exercises will further deepen friendly military relations between the two countries and also enhance professional skills and understanding between the soldiers of the two countries, the press release said.

articles.title: China launches crewed spaceship carrying first Pakistani astronaut to its space station
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) launched its Shenzhou-24 crewed spaceship carrying three astronauts , including Pakistan’s Muhammad Zeeshan Ali , the first foreign national to participate in the country’s crewed space programme. The spaceship, atop a Long March-2F carrier rocket, blasted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China, with officials declaring the launch successful minutes later. The crew comprises mission commander and spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Ali, who will become the first foreign astronaut to visit China’s orbiting Tiangong space station. Mr. Ali will return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after spending about a week in orbit, while Chinese astronauts typically stay at the station for about six months. The spacecraft is expected to dock with the Tiangong space station in a few hours. China built its own space station after it was reportedly excluded from the International Space Station (ISS) over concerns about the involvement of its military, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA), in its space programme. China is currently the only country operating its own space station, which became operational in 2022. Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998. NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — चीन वर्तमान में अपना स्वयं का अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन संचालित करने वाला एकमात्र देश है, जो 2022 में चालू हो गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Operational' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आपरेशनल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Operational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — तियांगोंग फुटबॉल पिच के आकार के आईएसएस की तुलना में अपेक्षाकृत छोटा है, जहां 1998 में लॉन्च होने के बाद से कई देशों के अंतरिक्ष यात्रियों ने 3,000 से अधिक प्रयोग किए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, नासा ने 2031 की शुरुआत में आईएसएस को रिटायर करने की योजना बनाई है, जिसमें स्पेसएक्स द्वारा विकसित किए जा रहे एक समर्पित डोरबिट वाहन का उपयोग करके इसे दक्षिण प्रशांत क्षेत्र में नियंत्रित पुन: प्रवेश के लिए निर्देशित किया जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — चीनी अधिकारियों ने कहा कि शेनझोउ-24 मिशन के मुख्य उद्देश्यों में शेनझोउ-23 चालक दल के साथ कक्षा में क्रू रोटेशन पूरा करना, नियमित स्टेशन संचालन को बनाए रखना, वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान करना और रखरखाव, सार्वजनिक आउटरीच और पेलोड परीक्षण करना शामिल है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Operational' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आपरेशनल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Operational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 China launches crewed spaceship carrying first Pakistani astronaut to its space station

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 11:41:02 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) launched its Shenzhou-24 crewed spaceship carrying three astronauts , including Pakistan’s Muhammad Zeeshan Ali , the first foreign national to participate in the country’s crewed space programme. The spaceship, atop a Long March-2F carrier rocket, blasted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China, with officials declaring the launch successful minutes later. The crew comprises mission commander and spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Ali, who will become the first foreign astronaut to visit China’s orbiting Tiangong space station. Mr. Ali will return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after spending about a week in orbit, while Chinese astronauts typically stay at the station for about six months. The spacecraft is expected to dock with the Tiangong space station in a few hours. China built its own space station after it was reportedly excluded from the International Space Station (ISS) over concerns about the involvement of its military, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA), in its space programme. China is currently the only country operating its own space station, which became operational in 2022. Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998. NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.

A. Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m.

D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Riyadh; New Delhi condemns strike
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two Indians were among those injured in an attack on a financial district in Riyadh that triggered strong condemnation from New Delhi. India also denounced continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district. The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said. The attack was carried out on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Local authorities said the injured included two Saudi citizens, three Nepalese and four Egyptian nationals. The MEA said India strongly condemns the attack in Riyadh as well as the continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability. We call for immediate cessation of such attacks,” it said in a statement. India also reiterated its firm solidarity with the people and government of Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed its unwavering support to the Kingdom in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We earnestly hope that peace and normalcy will return to the region at the earliest,” the MEA said. There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, especially after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia. The West Asia conflict began in February following attacks on Iran by the U.S. and Israel. New Delhi has consistently called for finding a solution to the conflict through dialogue and diplomacy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India has been specifically voicing serious concern over the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s civilian infrastructure and economic assets, cautioning that such strikes undermine regional stability and threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Riyadh; New Delhi condemns strike

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 11:28:03 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two Indians were among those injured in an attack on a financial district in Riyadh that triggered strong condemnation from New Delhi. India also denounced continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district. The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said. The attack was carried out on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Local authorities said the injured included two Saudi citizens, three Nepalese and four Egyptian nationals. The MEA said India strongly condemns the attack in Riyadh as well as the continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability. We call for immediate cessation of such attacks,” it said in a statement. India also reiterated its firm solidarity with the people and government of Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed its unwavering support to the Kingdom in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We earnestly hope that peace and normalcy will return to the region at the earliest,” the MEA said. There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, especially after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia. The West Asia conflict began in February following attacks on Iran by the U.S. and Israel. New Delhi has consistently called for finding a solution to the conflict through dialogue and diplomacy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India has been specifically voicing serious concern over the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s civilian infrastructure and economic assets, cautioning that such strikes undermine regional stability and threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

articles.title: North Korea declares a Swiss diplomat persona non grata and orders him to leave
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un,c ondemned Switzerland for imposing sanctions on a youth camp in eastern North Korea over its alleged role in the transfer of children from Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: North Korea on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) declared a senior Swiss diplomat heading the country's newly opened diplomatic office in Pyongyang persona non grata and ordered him to leave the country within 48 hours. The move came a day after Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, threatened to close the office. She condemned Switzerland for imposing sanctions on a youth camp in eastern North Korea over its alleged role in the transfer of children from Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine. The Korean Central News Agency said a senior Foreign Ministry official summoned Astier Sylvain, who heads the Swiss diplomatic office that opened in Pyongyang last month, and handed him a notice demanding the office's closure and his departure, in protest of the Swiss sanctions on the Songdowon International Children's Camp in Wonsan.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: North Korea / Switzerland / international relations / diplomacy

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (25 NOV)

1. Core Context & Background: Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un,c ondemned Switzerland for imposing sanctions on a youth camp in eastern North Korea over its alleged role in the transfer of children from Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: North Korea on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) declared a senior Swiss diplomat heading the country's newly opened diplomatic office in Pyongyang persona non grata and ordered him to leave the country within 48 hours. The move came a day after Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, threatened to close the office. She condemned Switzerland for imposing sanctions on a youth camp in eastern North Korea over its alleged role in the transfer of children from Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine. The Korean Central News Agency said a senior Foreign Ministry official summoned Astier Sylvain, who heads the Swiss diplomatic office that opened in Pyongyang last month, and handed him a notice demanding the office's closure and his departure, in protest of the Swiss sanctions on the Songdowon International Children's Camp in Wonsan.

articles.title: Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days. This information was provided in response to an RTI query to AIIMS, RML Hospital, Safdarjung Hospital and the Delhi State Cancer Institute. Under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, data regarding lung cancer cases and associated deaths between January 1, 2020, and July 31, 2026, were requested from the hospitals. Safdarjung Hospital only provided the number of lung cancer deaths but did not disclose the total number of cases. A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it. According to information provided in response to separate RTI applications filed by PTI Bhasha, 6,581 lung cancer cases were recorded across three of the four hospitals (excluding Safdarjung), averaging 83 cases per month. Across all four hospitals, 913 deaths were reported, which translates to one patient dying every three days. The national capital is currently grappling with a severe air pollution crisis, an annual affair now in November, which is observed as the Lung Cancer Awareness Month. Although health experts state that long-term exposure to air pollution increases the risk of lung cancer, it is not the sole cause. Smoking and genetic mutations are two of the other contributing factors. The highest number of cases was recorded at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS). This central government hospital provided data for the period from January 2020 to March 2026, during which 4,860 cases of lung cancer were registered and 158 deaths occurred. This averages to approximately 65 cases per month, with two patient deaths occurring monthly. According to data from the Delhi State Cancer Institute (DSCI), 1,613 cases of lung cancer were reported between January 1, 2020, and July 2026, resulting in 354 deaths. This translates to an average of 20 cases per month, with four patient deaths occurring monthly during this period.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The institute noted that in 2021, the disease was also diagnosed in two children, and over a span of about six and a half years, 351 women were found to be suffering from lung cancer. However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths.

options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths." (Hinglish Arth: हालाँकि, इसने मौतों का लिंग-पृथक विवरण प्रदान नहीं किया।)

hinglishTracks.en: A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन रोगियों के डेटा के लिए भी अनुरोध किया गया था जिन्होंने कभी धूम्रपान नहीं किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, none of the institutes provided any data on it
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हालाँकि, किसी भी संस्थान ने इस पर कोई डेटा उपलब्ध नहीं कराया। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पिछले साढ़े छह साल की अवधि में राष्ट्रीय राजधानी के प्रमुख सरकारी अस्पतालों में हर महीने फेफड़ों के कैंसर के लगभग 83 मामले दर्ज किए गए, जिसमें हर तीन दिन में एक मरीज की मौत हुई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Hospital' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अस्पताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Hospital' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह जानकारी एक आरटीआई के जवाब में एम्स, आरएमएल अस्पताल, सफदरजंग अस्पताल और दिल्ली राज्य कैंसर संस्थान को दी गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, data regarding lung cancer cases and associated deaths between January 1, 2020, and July 31, 2026, were requested from the hospitals.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सूचना के अधिकार (आरटीआई) अधिनियम के तहत, अस्पतालों से 1 जनवरी, 2020 और 31 जुलाई, 2026 के बीच फेफड़ों के कैंसर के मामलों और संबंधित मौतों के डेटा का अनुरोध किया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Information' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जानकारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Information' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Safdarjung Hospital only provided the number of lung cancer deaths but did not disclose the total number of cases.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सफदरजंग अस्पताल ने केवल फेफड़ों के कैंसर से होने वाली मौतों की संख्या बताई लेकिन कुल मामलों की संख्या का खुलासा नहीं किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Hospital' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अस्पताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Hospital' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन रोगियों के डेटा के लिए भी अनुरोध किया गया था जिन्होंने कभी धूम्रपान नहीं किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to information provided in response to separate RTI applications filed by PTI Bhasha, 6,581 lung cancer cases were recorded across three of the four hospitals (excluding Safdarjung), averaging 83 cases per month.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पीटीआई भाषा द्वारा दायर अलग-अलग आरटीआई आवेदनों के जवाब में दी गई जानकारी के अनुसार, चार में से तीन अस्पतालों (सफदरजंग को छोड़कर) में फेफड़ों के कैंसर के 6,581 मामले दर्ज किए गए, औसतन 83 मामले प्रति माह।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Information' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जानकारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Information' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The national capital is currently grappling with a severe air pollution crisis, an annual affair now in November, which is observed as the Lung Cancer Awareness Month.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — राष्ट्रीय राजधानी वर्तमान में गंभीर वायु प्रदूषण संकट से जूझ रही है, यह एक वार्षिक मामला है जो अब नवंबर में मनाया जाता है, जिसे फेफड़ों के कैंसर जागरूकता माह के रूप में मनाया जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Pollution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रदूषण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Pollution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हालांकि स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञों का कहना है कि वायु प्रदूषण के लंबे समय तक संपर्क में रहने से फेफड़ों के कैंसर का खतरा बढ़ जाता है, लेकिन यह एकमात्र कारण नहीं है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Pollution' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रदूषण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Pollution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Smoking and genetic mutations are two of the other contributing factors.

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 11:51:20 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days. This information was provided in response to an RTI query to AIIMS, RML Hospital, Safdarjung Hospital and the Delhi State Cancer Institute. Under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, data regarding lung cancer cases and associated deaths between January 1, 2020, and July 31, 2026, were requested from the hospitals. Safdarjung Hospital only provided the number of lung cancer deaths but did not disclose the total number of cases. A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it. According to information provided in response to separate RTI applications filed by PTI Bhasha, 6,581 lung cancer cases were recorded across three of the four hospitals (excluding Safdarjung), averaging 83 cases per month. Across all four hospitals, 913 deaths were reported, which translates to one patient dying every three days. articles.title: India warns against using tech for strategic one-upmanship, calls for inclusive AI governance

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India’s UN Ambassador asserted that amid the rapid integration of AI into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for the use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voiced concern over the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, calling out the tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers as it underscored that technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities. Addressing the Security Council’s high-level open debate on Maintenance of International Peace and Security on ‘Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change’, India’s Permanent Representative to the UN Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni said AI systems can inadvertently perpetuate biases related to gender, language and socio-economic background. Delivered India's statement at the UN Security Council high-level open debate convened by Latvia. Speaking on the theme, "Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change", I highlighted four key considerations: 1️⃣ Technology must remain human-centric and an instrument of peace 2️⃣ The application of emerging technologies in conflict settings must be responsible, human-centric, respect sovereignty, and adhere to international law 3️⃣ We must address threats posed by misuse of emerging technologies such as AI 4️⃣ Technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities. We must address technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes. Countries of the Global South should not be tested as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, regulated and deployed. “We note with concern the emerging medium- and long-term trends of technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, and a tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, are regulated and are deployed,” Mr. Parvathaneni said. “AI must not reduce human beings to mere data points or raw material. India supports inclusive international cooperation on technology governance, including through the United Nations, with due regard to national priorities and developmental needs,” he said. He emphasised that technology should serve humanity, strengthen international cooperation, and advance the cause of lasting peace. “Technology may inform human judgement but cannot and should not replace it,” he said. India also asserted that amid the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans. “Rapid technological advances are fundamentally transforming the nature of conflict and the international security landscape. Artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and emerging digital technologies present unprecedented opportunities but also introduce new vulnerabilities and risks across the entire conflict cycle,” Mr. Parvathaneni said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He added that the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military, intelligence, and civilian spheres has fundamentally transformed the landscape of international peace and security.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 India warns against using tech for strategic one-upmanship, calls for inclusive AI governance

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 11:48:32 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India’s UN Ambassador asserted that amid the rapid integration of AI into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for the use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voiced concern over the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, calling out the tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers as it underscored that technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities. Addressing the Security Council’s high-level open debate on Maintenance of International Peace and Security on ‘Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change’, India’s Permanent Representative to the UN Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni said AI systems can inadvertently perpetuate biases related to gender, language and socio-economic background. Delivered India's statement at the UN Security Council high-level open debate convened by Latvia. Speaking on the theme, "Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change", I highlighted four key considerations: 1️⃣ Technology must remain human-centric and an instrument of peace 2️⃣ The application of emerging technologies in conflict settings must be responsible, human-centric, respect sovereignty, and adhere to international law 3️⃣ We must address threats posed by misuse of emerging technologies such as AI 4️⃣ Technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities. We must address technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes. Countries of the Global South should not be tested as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, regulated and deployed. “We note with concern the emerging medium- and long-term trends of technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, and a tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, are regulated and are deployed,” Mr. Parvathaneni said. “AI must not reduce human beings to mere data points or raw material. India supports inclusive international cooperation on technology governance, including through the United Nations, with due regard to national priorities and developmental needs,” he said. He emphasised that technology should serve humanity, strengthen international cooperation, and advance the cause of lasting peace. “Technology may inform human judgement but cannot and should not replace it,” he said. India also asserted that amid the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans. “Rapid technological advances are fundamentally transforming the nature of conflict and the international security landscape. Artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and emerging digital technologies present unprecedented opportunities but also introduce new vulnerabilities and risks across the entire conflict cycle,” Mr. Parvathaneni said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He added that the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military, intelligence, and civilian spheres has fundamentally transformed the landscape of international peace and security.

समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing  |  ✖ Ant: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow
Responsibility (Noun)
ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Transformation (Noun)
परिवर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transformation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Representative (Adjective)
प्रतिनिधि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

articles.title: U.S. lawmakers raise alarm at FAA decision to deploy aviation AI tool nationally
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of two dozen U.S. House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said. “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.” The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.” The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हाउस डेमोक्रेट्स ने मंगलवार को एक प्रमुख सिस्टम विफलता से कुछ दिन पहले, 10 नवंबर को देश भर में हवाई यातायात नियंत्रकों की सहायता के लिए एक नया एआई उपकरण तैनात करने के संघीय विमानन प्रशासन के फैसले पर गंभीर चिंता जताई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Administration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence.

hinglishTracks.en: The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30.

hinglishTracks.en: “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कानून निर्माताओं ने लिखा, "हमें अभी तक कोई ठोस जानकारी नहीं मिली है जो यह साबित करती हो कि देश भर में विस्तार से पहले सिस्टम को ठीक से मान्य किया गया था।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सिस्टम, जिसे एयरस्पेस, रूट्स और ट्रैजेक्टरीज या स्मार्ट का रणनीतिक प्रबंधन कहा जाता है, यातायात प्रवाह की भविष्यवाणी करने और संभावित संघर्षों की पहचान करने के लिए एयरलाइन शेड्यूल, मौसम, हवाई अड्डे की क्षमता, हवाई क्षेत्र की स्थितियों और परिचालन बाधाओं का विश्लेषण करने के लिए डेटा का उपयोग करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पत्र में 13 नवंबर को लगभग पांच घंटे के राष्ट्रव्यापी ग्राउंड स्टॉप का हवाला दिया गया, जिसके कारण एफएए टेलीकॉम मुद्दे के कारण अनुमानित 1.5 मिलियन यात्रियों के लिए उड़ानें रद्द कर दी गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पत्र में कहा गया है, "संघीय सरकार विश्वास के संकट से जूझ रही है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “विमानन प्रणाली में अमेरिकियों का विश्वास हिल गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एफएए ने जिस अस्पष्टता और असंगतता के साथ स्मार्ट रोलआउट को संभाला है, उससे उस भरोसे को और भी कम करने का खतरा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कानूनविद यह जानना चाहते हैं कि स्मार्ट संचालन को मान्य करने के लिए एफएए द्वारा उपयोग किए गए डेटा और "स्मार्ट को प्रभावित करने वाले मुद्दों या आउटेज की स्थिति में विश्वसनीय एटीसी संचालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए" क्या अतिरेक मौजूद हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सांसदों ने उन रिपोर्टों का भी हवाला दिया कि एफएए ने उन कर्मचारियों के खिलाफ जवाबी कार्रवाई की हो सकती है जिन्होंने स्मार्ट की तेजी से तैनाती के बारे में सुरक्षा चिंताएं जताई थीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एफएए ने टिप्पणी से इनकार कर दिया और कहा कि वह सीधे सांसदों को जवाब देगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अमेरिकी परिवहन सचिव सीन डफी ने इस उपकरण को अनिवार्य रूप से "गूंगा एआई" कहा है और इस बात पर जोर दिया है कि सॉफ्टवेयर नहीं, बल्कि नियंत्रक प्रभारी बने रहेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Transportation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परिवहन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transportation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 U.S. lawmakers raise alarm at FAA decision to deploy aviation AI tool nationally

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:26:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of two dozen U.S. House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said. “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.” The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.” The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of two dozen U.S. House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said. “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.” The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.” The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.
