hinglishTracks.en: He set a goal not only for a peaceful region but also to take J&K to new heights,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने न केवल एक शांतिपूर्ण क्षेत्र के लिए बल्कि जम्मू-कश्मीर को नई ऊंचाइयों पर ले जाने का भी लक्ष्य रखा, ”श्री ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rijiju, while speaking at the Waqf Day-2026 at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रिजिजू, श्रीनगर में शेर-ए-कश्मीर कृषि विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी विश्वविद्यालय में वक्फ दिवस-2026 में बोलते हुए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Agricultural' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Rijiju said Kashmir was moving ahead at a very “fast pace”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — रिजिजू ने कहा कि कश्मीर बहुत तेज गति से आगे बढ़ रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Seeing the situation today, I can say India’s and J&K’s future is bright.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “आज की स्थिति को देखकर, मैं कह सकता हूं कि भारत और जम्मू-कश्मीर का भविष्य उज्ज्वल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: People of Kashmir are large hearted.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कश्मीर के लोग बड़े दिल वाले हैं.।

hinglishTracks.en: Today, sportsmen across the country wait to participate in the winter games at Gulmarg every year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आज, देश भर के खिलाड़ी हर साल गुलमर्ग में शीतकालीन खेलों में भाग लेने का इंतजार करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The concept, besides adventure and water sports, was introduced in 2019,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — साहसिक और जल खेलों के अलावा, इस अवधारणा को 2019 में पेश किया गया था, ”श्री ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Earlier in the day, the Union minister inaugurated the construction of Bibi Halima College of Nursing & Medical Technology (BHCNMT), at Kathi Darwaza, Rainawari, Srinagar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इससे पहले दिन में, केंद्रीय मंत्री ने काठी दरवाजा, रैनावारी, श्रीनगर में बीबी हलीमा कॉलेज ऑफ नर्सिंग एंड मेडिकल टेक्नोलॉजी (बीएचसीएनएमटी) के निर्माण का उद्घाटन किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: He said the alumni of the educational institute included 16 Kashmir University Gold Medalists, the highest among nursing colleges and over 10 international NCLEX qualifiers in the USA and Canada.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उन्होंने कहा कि शैक्षणिक संस्थान के पूर्व छात्रों में 16 कश्मीर विश्वविद्यालय के स्वर्ण पदक विजेता, नर्सिंग कॉलेजों में सबसे अधिक और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और कनाडा में 10 से अधिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय एनसीएलईएक्स क्वालीफायर शामिल हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्होंने कहा, "इसके स्नातक एसकेआईएमएस में लगभग 30% नर्सिंग अधिकारी और सरकारी मेडिकल कॉलेज से जुड़े अस्पतालों में 25% से अधिक नर्सिंग कार्यबल हैं।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रिजिजू ने कहा, “महिला तीर्थयात्रियों के लिए प्रार्थना करने के लिए हजरतबल में बनाया गया स्थान सुंदर और सौंदर्य की दृष्टि से मनभावन है।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Close to realising PM Narendra Modi’s dream for Kashmir, says Kiren Rijiju

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 02:32:38 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi,’ said Kiren Rijiju

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Terming the work of J&K Waqf Board as “the best-performing” in the country, Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs and Minority Affairs Kiren Rijiju on Monday (November 23, 2026) said the region is close to achieve the dream Prime Minister Narendra Modi has for it. Recalling his past tours of Kashmir as Minister of State (MOS) Home and as Law Minister, Mr. Rijiju said, “I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi. I must say we are very close to realising the dream PM Modi had for Kashmir. He set a goal not only for a peaceful region but also to take J&K to new heights,” said Mr. Rijiju, while speaking at the Waqf Day-2026 at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar. Mr. Rijiju said Kashmir was moving ahead at a very “fast pace”. “Seeing the situation today, I can say India’s and J&K’s future is bright. People of Kashmir are large hearted. Today, sportsmen across the country wait to participate in the winter games at Gulmarg every year. The concept, besides adventure and water sports, was introduced in 2019,” said Mr. Rijiju. Earlier in the day, the Union minister inaugurated the construction of Bibi Halima College of Nursing & Medical Technology (BHCNMT), at Kathi Darwaza, Rainawari, Srinagar. He said the alumni of the educational institute included 16 Kashmir University Gold Medalists, the highest among nursing colleges and over 10 international NCLEX qualifiers in the USA and Canada. “Its graduates also constitute around 30% of nursing officers at SKIMS and over 25% of the nursing workforce at Government Medical College-associated hospitals,” he added. Praising the arrangements and management at the Nursing College and also the works done at the Hazratnal shrine, Mr. Rijiju said, “The space created at Hazratbal for female pilgrims to offer prayers is beautiful and aesthetically pleasing. I congratulate the Chairperson of the Waqf Board, Darakhshan Andrabi, in this regard. It’s the best performing board in the country.” The Union Minister also highlighted the need to properly utilise and manage over nine lakh Waqf properties across the country. “It could bring significant socio-economic changes in the Muslim community. Poor and disadvantaged members of the Muslim community could benefit considerably if Waqf assets were utilised for their welfare, of which the J&K Waqf Board’s functioning is an example,” said Mr. Rijiju. He also congratulated Ms. Andrabi and her entire team for “undertaking development initiatives and improving facilities at important religious and public institutions”. Praising PM Modi for his vision. Mr. Andrabi said, “I became the first woman chairperson in 2022 and the board was constituted. There was no official structure then and the same was put in place. It is paying dividends.” National Conference (NC) leader and Member of Parliament (MP) Mian Altaf highlighted the role of Mr. Rijiju pertaining to Kashmir. “He [Rijiju] frequently visits Kashmir and has always loved people. He always tried to contribute to Kashmir as he held different ministries. We all dream to have a better Kashmir, even what it was 30 years ago. My sister Ms. Andrabi is doing work that deserves applaud too,” said Mr. Altaf.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir National Conference / national government / Narendra Modi

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: ‘I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi,’ said Kiren Rijiju
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Terming the work of J&K Waqf Board as “the best-performing” in the country, Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs and Minority Affairs Kiren Rijiju on Monday (November 23, 2026) said the region is close to achieve the dream Prime Minister Narendra Modi has for it. Recalling his past tours of Kashmir as Minister of State (MOS) Home and as Law Minister, Mr. Rijiju said, “I remember there were no large programmes as we visited frontier districts to meet soldiers and discuss how to realise the dream of PM Modi. I must say we are very close to realising the dream PM Modi had for Kashmir. He set a goal not only for a peaceful region but also to take J&K to new heights,” said Mr. Rijiju, while speaking at the Waqf Day-2026 at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar. Mr. Rijiju said Kashmir was moving ahead at a very “fast pace”. “Seeing the situation today, I can say India’s and J&K’s future is bright. People of Kashmir are large hearted. Today, sportsmen across the country wait to participate in the winter games at Gulmarg every year. The concept, besides adventure and water sports, was introduced in 2019,” said Mr. Rijiju. Earlier in the day, the Union minister inaugurated the construction of Bibi Halima College of Nursing & Medical Technology (BHCNMT), at Kathi Darwaza, Rainawari, Srinagar. He said the alumni of the educational institute included 16 Kashmir University Gold Medalists, the highest among nursing colleges and over 10 international NCLEX qualifiers in the USA and Canada. “Its graduates also constitute around 30% of nursing officers at SKIMS and over 25% of the nursing workforce at Government Medical College-associated hospitals,” he added. Praising the arrangements and management at the Nursing College and also the works done at the Hazratnal shrine, Mr. Rijiju said, “The space created at Hazratbal for female pilgrims to offer prayers is beautiful and aesthetically pleasing. I congratulate the Chairperson of the Waqf Board, Darakhshan Andrabi, in this regard. It’s the best performing board in the country.” The Union Minister also highlighted the need to properly utilise and manage over nine lakh Waqf properties across the country. “It could bring significant socio-economic changes in the Muslim community. Poor and disadvantaged members of the Muslim community could benefit considerably if Waqf assets were utilised for their welfare, of which the J&K Waqf Board’s functioning is an example,” said Mr. Rijiju. He also congratulated Ms. Andrabi and her entire team for “undertaking development initiatives and improving facilities at important religious and public institutions”. Praising PM Modi for his vision. Mr. Andrabi said, “I became the first woman chairperson in 2022 and the board was constituted. There was no official structure then and the same was put in place. It is paying dividends.” National Conference (NC) leader and Member of Parliament (MP) Mian Altaf highlighted the role of Mr. Rijiju pertaining to Kashmir. “He [Rijiju] frequently visits Kashmir and has always loved people. He always tried to contribute to Kashmir as he held different ministries. We all dream to have a better Kashmir, even what it was 30 years ago. My sister Ms. Andrabi is doing work that deserves applaud too,” said Mr. Altaf.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir National Conference / national government / Narendra Modi

articles.title: Will bank manager accept Kayalvizhi Alagiri’s apology, asks Madras High Court
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan grants a day’s time for the police to find out if the victim, subjected to physical assault, would agree for closure of criminal prosecution against the accused

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Madras High Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) wanted to know whether a bank manager would be willing to accept an apology from former Union Minister M.K. Alagiri’s daughter Kayalvizhi Alagiri and agree for closure of a criminal case registered against her for allegedly slapping him supposedly due to anger management issues on July 20, 2026. Justice V. Lakshminarayanan directed the Inspector of Shastri Nagar police station in Adyar, Chennai to make sure that Harsheen Singh, a branch manager with State Bank of India, appears before the court on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) if he is willing to accept the apology and give a quietus to the issue than continuing the prosecution. The direction was issued during the hearing of a writ petition (criminal) filed by Ms. Alagiri seeking a direction to the police to register a First Information Report (FIR) against the bank manager on the basis of a counter complaint lodged by her on July 25, 2026 accusing him of having subjected her to verbal abuse, aggressive intimidation and public humiliation. Government Advocate (criminal side) S. Yogaraja Sekar told the judge that Ms. Alagiri was the owner of a commercial building in which the bank branch was functioning. There was a dispute between the landlady and the tenant over the non-functioning of an elevator in the building and a quarrel over that issue had led to a physical assault against the bank manager on July 20, 2026. The police had intially registered a First Information Report (FIR) against Ms. Alagiri under various provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for abusing and assaulting the bank manager. It also completed the investigation and filed a charge sheet before a Metropolitan Magistrate in Chennai. The Magistrate was slated to take up the case for hearing next on December 22, 2026, the law officer said. In so far as the counter complaint lodged by the landlady against the bank manager was concerned, the Government Advocate said, the police had conducted a preliminary inquiry but did not find any material to substantiate any of the allegations levelled by her. Therefore, the investigating officer had dropped further action and closed her complaint, he added.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On his part, the petitioner’s counsel S.L. Sudarsanam said, his client would apologise, if necessary and in order to give a quietus to the entire issue.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Will bank manager accept Kayalvizhi Alagiri’s apology, asks Madras High Court

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 02:29:04 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan grants a day’s time for the police to find out if the victim, subjected to physical assault, would agree for closure of criminal prosecution against the accused

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Madras High Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) wanted to know whether a bank manager would be willing to accept an apology from former Union Minister M.K. Alagiri’s daughter Kayalvizhi Alagiri and agree for closure of a criminal case registered against her for allegedly slapping him supposedly due to anger management issues on July 20, 2026. Justice V. Lakshminarayanan directed the Inspector of Shastri Nagar police station in Adyar, Chennai to make sure that Harsheen Singh, a branch manager with State Bank of India, appears before the court on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) if he is willing to accept the apology and give a quietus to the issue than continuing the prosecution. The direction was issued during the hearing of a writ petition (criminal) filed by Ms. Alagiri seeking a direction to the police to register a First Information Report (FIR) against the bank manager on the basis of a counter complaint lodged by her on July 25, 2026 accusing him of having subjected her to verbal abuse, aggressive intimidation and public humiliation. Government Advocate (criminal side) S. Yogaraja Sekar told the judge that Ms. Alagiri was the owner of a commercial building in which the bank branch was functioning. There was a dispute between the landlady and the tenant over the non-functioning of an elevator in the building and a quarrel over that issue had led to a physical assault against the bank manager on July 20, 2026. The police had intially registered a First Information Report (FIR) against Ms. Alagiri under various provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for abusing and assaulting the bank manager. It also completed the investigation and filed a charge sheet before a Metropolitan Magistrate in Chennai. The Magistrate was slated to take up the case for hearing next on December 22, 2026, the law officer said. In so far as the counter complaint lodged by the landlady against the bank manager was concerned, the Government Advocate said, the police had conducted a preliminary inquiry but did not find any material to substantiate any of the allegations levelled by her. Therefore, the investigating officer had dropped further action and closed her complaint, he added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On his part, the petitioner’s counsel S.L. Sudarsanam said, his client would apologise, if necessary and in order to give a quietus to the entire issue.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

डराना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intimidation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Prosecution (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Prosecution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Information (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Information' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

A. Lakshminarayanan grants a day’s time for the police to find out if the victim, subjected to physical assault, would agree for closure of criminal...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Will bank manager accept Kayalvizhi Alagiri’s ap' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Will bank manager accept Kayalvizhi Alagiri’s' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Will bank manager accept Kayalvizhi Alagiri’s' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Lakshminarayanan grants a day’s time for the police to find out if the victim, subjected to physical assault, would agree for closure of criminal..." (Hinglish Arth: लक्ष्मीनारायणन ने पुलिस को यह पता लगाने के लिए एक दिन का समय दिया कि क्या शारीरिक उत्पीड़न का शिकार पीड़ित आरोपी के खिलाफ आपराधिक मुकदमा बंद करने के लिए सहमत होगा।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Will bank manager accept Kayalvizhi Alagiri’s apology, asks Madras High Court"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Sudarsanam said, his client would apologise, if necessary and in order to give a quietus to the entire issue." (Hinglish Arth: सुदर्शनम ने कहा, यदि आवश्यक हुआ तो उनका मुवक्किल पूरे मामले को शांत करने के लिए माफी मांगेगा।)

articles.title: Rajasthan women’s varsity signs MoU with BRICS nations for global leadership centre
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Banasthali Vidyapith, a residential women’s university situated in Rajasthan’s Tonk district, on Monday (November 23, 2026) signed a memorandum of understanding with the BRICS nations for establishment of a centre for global women’s leadership. The new centre will work for women’s educational empowerment and leadership development on a global scale.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The MoU was signed on the conclusion of a five-day BRICS women leaders’ summit, organised on the university campus, which focused on promoting women’s leadership, cultural exchanges, and mutual cooperation and innovative research across the 11 BRICS member countries. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla , who inaugurated the summit, called upon women leaders to harness their collective leadership, experience and innovative capabilities to address global challenges and shape a “more peaceful, stable and prosperous” world. He also laid emphasis on cooperation among BRICS nations. Banasthali Vidyapith organised the summit in partnership with Eurasian Women’s Forum, Russia’s Federation Council, Senezh Management Group of Russia and BRICS Youth Alliance. Vice-Chancellor Ina Aditya Shastri said the participants would act as torchbearers for women’s leadership development in their respective countries. Extensive discussions were held during the summit on developing women’s leadership in the fields of politics, higher education, science and technology, entrepreneurship, administration, and social development. The speakers agreed to formulate future action plans to address the challenges of inequality in opportunities, limited access to financial resources and socio-cultural barriers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senezh Management Workshop’s First Vice-Rector Sergey Vladimirovich Bocharov said the BRICS countries had much to learn from India and Banasthali Vidyapith’s model of women’s leadership. He said the new centre would help expand women’s role in civil society and strengthen their decision-making capacity.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Rajasthan women’s varsity signs MoU with BRICS nations for global leadership centre

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 02:15:25 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Banasthali Vidyapith, a residential women’s university situated in Rajasthan’s Tonk district, on Monday (November 23, 2026) signed a memorandum of understanding with the BRICS nations for establishment of a centre for global women’s leadership. The new centre will work for women’s educational empowerment and leadership development on a global scale.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The MoU was signed on the conclusion of a five-day BRICS women leaders’ summit, organised on the university campus, which focused on promoting women’s leadership, cultural exchanges, and mutual cooperation and innovative research across the 11 BRICS member countries. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla , who inaugurated the summit, called upon women leaders to harness their collective leadership, experience and innovative capabilities to address global challenges and shape a “more peaceful, stable and prosperous” world. He also laid emphasis on cooperation among BRICS nations. Banasthali Vidyapith organised the summit in partnership with Eurasian Women’s Forum, Russia’s Federation Council, Senezh Management Group of Russia and BRICS Youth Alliance. Vice-Chancellor Ina Aditya Shastri said the participants would act as torchbearers for women’s leadership development in their respective countries. Extensive discussions were held during the summit on developing women’s leadership in the fields of politics, higher education, science and technology, entrepreneurship, administration, and social development. The speakers agreed to formulate future action plans to address the challenges of inequality in opportunities, limited access to financial resources and socio-cultural barriers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senezh Management Workshop’s First Vice-Rector Sergey Vladimirovich Bocharov said the BRICS countries had much to learn from India and Banasthali Vidyapith’s model of women’s leadership. He said the new centre would help expand women’s role in civil society and strengthen their decision-making capacity.

articles.title: Proposal for extending scholarship to Sri Lankan students to pursue medical education in Tamil Nadu
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Sri Lankan Deputy High Commission (SLDHC) in Chennai is proposing to strengthen cooperation in medical education in Tamil Nadu, including the possibility of extending scholarships to Sri Lankan students. Sri Lankan Deputy High Commissioner in Chennai Ganesanathan Geathiswaran met Health Minister K.G. Arunraj in this regard recently.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “During the meeting, discussion focused on further strengthening cooperation in the field of medical education, including the possibility of extending scholarships to Sri Lankan students to pursue medical studies in Tamil Nadu under a proposed 50/50 scholarship between the government of Tamil Nadu and the university concerned,” SLDHC said in a social media post.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Geathiswaran meeting with the Minister last week also explored the potential for establishing student exchange programmes for medical students and postgraduate trainees, including opportunities for clinical rotations, academic exchanges and professional engagement between medical institutions in Sri Lanka and Tamil Nadu, it said.

articles.title: India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mikki Kivikoski said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “India and Finland are looking to deepen economic cooperation by strengthening ties between their startup ecosystems and promoting greater two-way investment,” Finnish Ambassador to India Mikko Kivikoski has said. "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And of course, at the end of the day, this is all about advancing the economic cooperation between our countries. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mr. Kivikoski told PTI . The Ambassador was speaking at an unconventional startup event held at the Embassy of Finland in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026), where entrepreneurs stepped into an ice-cold pool to pitch their ideas, drawing on Finland's winter-swimming tradition. "We have quite a long tradition in Finland for these kinds of events," Mr. Kivikoski said. "This year has been record-high when it comes to interaction and engagement between Finland and India," he said, referring to visits by the Finnish Prime Minister and President, as well as meetings between the leaders of the two countries. The Ambassador said the two sides agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership in Digitalisation and Sustainability during Finnish President Alexander Stubb's state visit to India in March. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met his Finnish counterpart, Petteri Orpo, in New Delhi on the sidelines of the AI Impact Summit in February and in Oslo on the margins of the 3rd India-Nordic Summit in May. Mr. Kivikoski also referred to the visits to Finland by India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal during the summer. "We see India as a trusted partner when it comes to the Indo-Pacific area," he said. The Ambassador said the India-Finland relationship was increasingly moving beyond conventional trade towards a partnership involving investments and people-to-people exchanges. "What we are seeing already, and what is happening between the European Union and India and between India and Finland, is that we are now talking about partnership. It's not anymore about me selling something to you and you selling something to me," he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "There are more and more Finnish companies coming to the Indian market and more and more Indian companies going to the Finnish market. And of course we hope, and we are confident, that this dynamism will continue in the future," he said.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #18 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:27:31 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mikki Kivikoski said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “India and Finland are looking to deepen economic cooperation by strengthening ties between their startup ecosystems and promoting greater two-way investment,” Finnish Ambassador to India Mikko Kivikoski has said. "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And of course, at the end of the day, this is all about advancing the economic cooperation between our countries. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mr. Kivikoski told PTI . The Ambassador was speaking at an unconventional startup event held at the Embassy of Finland in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026), where entrepreneurs stepped into an ice-cold pool to pitch their ideas, drawing on Finland's winter-swimming tradition. "We have quite a long tradition in Finland for these kinds of events," Mr. Kivikoski said. "This year has been record-high when it comes to interaction and engagement between Finland and India," he said, referring to visits by the Finnish Prime Minister and President, as well as meetings between the leaders of the two countries. The Ambassador said the two sides agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership in Digitalisation and Sustainability during Finnish President Alexander Stubb's state visit to India in March. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met his Finnish counterpart, Petteri Orpo, in New Delhi on the sidelines of the AI Impact Summit in February and in Oslo on the margins of the 3rd India-Nordic Summit in May. Mr. Kivikoski also referred to the visits to Finland by India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal during the summer. "We see India as a trusted partner when it comes to the Indo-Pacific area," he said. The Ambassador said the India-Finland relationship was increasingly moving beyond conventional trade towards a partnership involving investments and people-to-people exchanges. "What we are seeing already, and what is happening between the European Union and India and between India and Finland, is that we are now talking about partnership. It's not anymore about me selling something to you and you selling something to me," he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "There are more and more Finnish companies coming to the Indian market and more and more Indian companies going to the Finnish market. And of course we hope, and we are confident, that this dynamism will continue in the future," he said.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Unconventional (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Unconventional' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Digitalisation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Digitalisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties thro' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties t' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties t' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: ""We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors." (Hinglish Arth: "हम भारतीय स्टार्टअप अभिनेताओं के साथ और अधिक जुड़ना चाहते हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. And of course we hope, and we are confident, that this dynamism will continue in the future," he said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "And of course we hope, and we are confident, that this dynamism will continue in the future," he said." (Hinglish Arth: और निश्चित रूप से हम आशा करते हैं, और हमें विश्वास है कि यह गतिशीलता भविष्य में भी जारी रहेगी," उन्होंने कहा।)

articles.title: Chinese neuroscientist at Princeton is held by ICE after detention at Washington airport
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘News of Eva’s detention is distressing for me and many members of the Princeton University community,’ Rodney Priestley, dean of the university’s graduate school, said in a statement

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Chinese neuroscience researcher at Princeton University is in the custody of immigration authorities after she was detained while trying to get on a flight back from Washington, marking another instance of federal enforcement at airports. Eva Yi Xie, a third-year doctoral student at Princeton, was detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on Thursday (November 19, 2026) as she tried to fly back to New Jersey from a conference in the nation's capital, her university adviser Carlos Brody said in a social media post. The Department of Homeland Security, which oversees ICE, says Ms. Xie overstayed her visa and did not have authorisation to study in the United States. “News of Eva's detention is distressing for me and many members of the Princeton University community,” Rodney Priestley, dean of the university's graduate school, said in a statement. "We hope Eva will soon be able to resume her studies at Princeton.” Two days after Ms. Xie was taken into custody in Washington, masked immigration officers detained a father and daughter on an airport jet bridge in Seattle. ICE has ramped up detentions at airports since the summer, especially targeting people it says have overstayed their visas. Kerry Doyle, Ms. Xie's lawyer, said she came to the U.S. at age 14 with her family from China and has had an asylum application pending for years. Mr. Doyle insisted that Ms. Xie has permission to live, work and study in the U.S. while her case is pending. Mr. Doyle said Ms. Xie is being held in ICE's Caroline Detention Centre in Virginia. DHS said in a statement that Ms. Xie came to the United States on a temporary visa on March 16, 2016, but “chose to violate our nation's laws by refusing to depart by the required date of September 15, 2016.” The agency said she did not have valid permission to study in the U.S. and “a pending application does not confer legal status.”

articles.title: Federal appeals court gives President Donald Trump path to erasing hush money conviction
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The panel ordered a lower court to promptly issue a decision on whether the case should remain in federal court; if that happens, Mr. Trump could then argue that the verdict should be discarded because of Presidential immunity

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A federal appeals court on Monday (November 23, 2026) gave U.S. President Donald Trump a new pathway to erasing his hush money criminal conviction, moving the case to a federal court where he could seek to have it dismissed on immunity grounds. A three-judge panel of the 2nd US Circuit Court of Appeals reversed a lower court decision that had kept the case in state court in New York, where Mr. Trump was tried and convicted on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records to obscure a $130,000 payment to adult film performer Stormy Daniels. The panel ordered a lower court to promptly issue a decision on whether the case should remain in federal court. If that happens, Mr. Trump could then argue that the verdict should be discarded because of Presidential immunity. The decision also set in motion a halt to proceedings in Mr. Trump's simultaneous state court appeal. Trump denies wrongdoing and was given no punishment in the case, which made him the first U.S. President convicted of a crime.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In a two-page order, the 2nd Circuit panel said it disagreed with the late US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein's earlier denial of Mr. Trump's request to move the historic case from state court to federal court, a process known as removal.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Federal appeals court gives President Donald Trump path to erasing hush money conviction

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 03:06:25 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The panel ordered a lower court to promptly issue a decision on whether the case should remain in federal court; if that happens, Mr. Trump could then argue that the verdict should be discarded because of Presidential immunity

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A federal appeals court on Monday (November 23, 2026) gave U.S. President Donald Trump a new pathway to erasing his hush money criminal conviction, moving the case to a federal court where he could seek to have it dismissed on immunity grounds. A three-judge panel of the 2nd US Circuit Court of Appeals reversed a lower court decision that had kept the case in state court in New York, where Mr. Trump was tried and convicted on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records to obscure a $130,000 payment to adult film performer Stormy Daniels. The panel ordered a lower court to promptly issue a decision on whether the case should remain in federal court. If that happens, Mr. Trump could then argue that the verdict should be discarded because of Presidential immunity. The decision also set in motion a halt to proceedings in Mr. Trump's simultaneous state court appeal. Trump denies wrongdoing and was given no punishment in the case, which made him the first U.S. President convicted of a crime.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In a two-page order, the 2nd Circuit panel said it disagreed with the late US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein's earlier denial of Mr. Trump's request to move the historic case from state court to federal court, a process known as removal.

articles.title: A framework for nuclear risk reduction cannot wait
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Shenzhen offers an opening, but sustained engagement between Washington, Moscow and Beijing must now follow

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For the first time since 1972, there is no treaty formally restricting the world’s largest nuclear arsenals. New START (New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) expired in February, and nine months later, a successor treaty is still far from being drafted. Russia had offered to keep observing New START’s limits for a year if the United States did the same. Instead, the U.S. has pushed for an “improved” agreement, insisting that any nuclear treaty must involve China, which understandably has its own reservations. On November 19, the leaders of the three countries met for the first time on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen. They issued a joint declaration reaffirming that a nuclear war must never be fought. They also pledged subsequent talks on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation. However, there are no provisions for the verification of compliance with these commitments, and no date seems to have been fixed for further talks. Despite Shenzhen, the underlying tension between the three countries’ positions remains. Each country’s position makes sense from where it sits, but at a time fraught with conflict, further complicated by emerging technologies, this treaty-less scenario cannot continue indefinitely.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: USA / China / Russia / nuclear weapons / nuclear policy / treaty / summit / war / United Kingdom / France / Iran / Israel-US strikes on Iran / Taiwan / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / missile systems / Artificial Intelligence / United Nations / security measures

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 A framework for nuclear risk reduction cannot wait

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 01:12:14 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Shenzhen offers an opening, but sustained engagement between Washington, Moscow and Beijing must now follow

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For the first time since 1972, there is no treaty formally restricting the world’s largest nuclear arsenals. New START (New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) expired in February, and nine months later, a successor treaty is still far from being drafted. Russia had offered to keep observing New START’s limits for a year if the United States did the same. Instead, the U.S. has pushed for an “improved” agreement, insisting that any nuclear treaty must involve China, which understandably has its own reservations. On November 19, the leaders of the three countries met for the first time on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen. They issued a joint declaration reaffirming that a nuclear war must never be fought. They also pledged subsequent talks on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation. However, there are no provisions for the verification of compliance with these commitments, and no date seems to have been fixed for further talks. Despite Shenzhen, the underlying tension between the three countries’ positions remains. Each country’s position makes sense from where it sits, but at a time fraught with conflict, further complicated by emerging technologies, this treaty-less scenario cannot continue indefinitely.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: USA / China / Russia / nuclear weapons / nuclear policy / treaty / summit / war / United Kingdom / France / Iran / Israel-US strikes on Iran / Taiwan / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / missile systems / Artificial Intelligence / United Nations / security measures

articles.title: BJP MLA Rekha Patra’s condition improves, legislator remains under observation
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Rekha Patra is now able to speak and communicate any physical discomfort to doctors, while the slurring in her speech has also reduced significantly

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The health condition of BJP MLA Rekha Patra has improved, with her slurred speech reducing considerably, but doctors have kept her in the intensive care unit (ICU) for close observation, hospital sources said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The Hingalganj MLA was taken off ventilator support on Monday (November 23, 2026) and has not required it since. She is now able to speak and communicate any physical discomfort to doctors, while the slurring in her speech has also reduced significantly, BJP leader Archana Das Majumdar said. However, the three-member medical team treating her is not willing to take any chances and has recommended that she remain in the ICU for continued monitoring. Hospital sources said she was still receiving supplemental oxygen due to low oxygen levels in her body. While other clinical parameters indicate a positive recovery, doctors remain concerned about possible complications arising from the poisoning. Following the suspected poisoning, excessive saliva had accumulated in Ms. Patra's mouth. As she was not fully conscious, some saliva entered her lungs, affecting oxygen supply to the body, an earlier CT scan had found. Doctors said the effects of impaired oxygen supply to the lungs may not become immediately apparent and could manifest after some delay. A repeat CT scan of her chest was scheduled for Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon to assess the extent of any lung damage. Her further recovery would depend, among other factors, on the findings of the scan, they said. Meanwhile, doctors are yet to establish the exact composition of the suspected poison detected in her stomach.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the medical team, the substance found in her stomach was described as a herbal larvicide (herbal pesticide), but its precise ingredients remain unknown.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 BJP MLA Rekha Patra’s condition improves, legislator remains under observation

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:14:24 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Rekha Patra is now able to speak and communicate any physical discomfort to doctors, while the slurring in her speech has also reduced significantly

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The health condition of BJP MLA Rekha Patra has improved, with her slurred speech reducing considerably, but doctors have kept her in the intensive care unit (ICU) for close observation, hospital sources said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The Hingalganj MLA was taken off ventilator support on Monday (November 23, 2026) and has not required it since. She is now able to speak and communicate any physical discomfort to doctors, while the slurring in her speech has also reduced significantly, BJP leader Archana Das Majumdar said. However, the three-member medical team treating her is not willing to take any chances and has recommended that she remain in the ICU for continued monitoring. Hospital sources said she was still receiving supplemental oxygen due to low oxygen levels in her body. While other clinical parameters indicate a positive recovery, doctors remain concerned about possible complications arising from the poisoning. Following the suspected poisoning, excessive saliva had accumulated in Ms. Patra's mouth. As she was not fully conscious, some saliva entered her lungs, affecting oxygen supply to the body, an earlier CT scan had found. Doctors said the effects of impaired oxygen supply to the lungs may not become immediately apparent and could manifest after some delay. A repeat CT scan of her chest was scheduled for Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon to assess the extent of any lung damage. Her further recovery would depend, among other factors, on the findings of the scan, they said. Meanwhile, doctors are yet to establish the exact composition of the suspected poison detected in her stomach.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the medical team, the substance found in her stomach was described as a herbal larvicide (herbal pesticide), but its precise ingredients remain unknown.

articles.title: Rift within Congress: Rajmohan Unnithan challenges Shafi Parambil to public debate, warns ‘teacher and disciple will be exposed’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Unnithan said he was ‘ready to end his political career' if Shafi Parambil could prove that his allegations were baseless

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Intensifying the internal conflict within the Congress in Keralam, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan on Tuesday launched a sharp attack on fellow party leader Shafi Parambil, MP, alleging that a coordinated cyber campaign was being orchestrated against him and warning that he would expose those behind it if the attacks continued. Challenging Mr. Parambil to an open public debate, Mr Unnithan said he was “ready to end his political career” if Mr Parambil could prove that his allegations were baseless. He also claimed that he had recorded all relevant details in his personal diary and warned that the people involved, whom he described as “the teacher and the disciple”, would eventually be exposed. Mr Unnithan dismissed the claim that Mr. Parambil belonged to the ‘A’ group in the Congress, saying it would be “the eighth wonder of the world” to describe him as an A group leader. He clarified that he had not insulted Mr Parambil but had only stated that he did not belong to the group. Taking aim at those invoking the legacy of the late former Chief Minister Oommen Chandy, Mr Unnithan said many Congress leaders had stayed away when Chandy was being targeted, while others were concerned about protecting the public image. He questioned where those now speaking about the “Oommen Chandy school of politics” had been at the time. He also maintained that he had not received any personal benefits in Chandy’s name. Mr Unnithan alleged that the social media attacks against him were being conducted through fake accounts as part of a deliberate campaign rather than being spontaneous criticism. He claimed that the operation was being “controlled from Adoor and from a particular house.” Referring to a flat in Panampilly Nagar and a vehicle bearing the registration number 20-20, he hinted that he possessed information about those involved but declined to disclose further details immediately. “Everything is in my diary, the teacher and the disciple will both be trapped,” he warned, adding that he should not be unnecessarily provoked. He warned that if forced to reveal everything, “the respectable public image of certain people will be torn apart.” Mr Unnithan said he had always been “a lone fighter” within the party and had stood with former Congress leader K Karunakaran and Oommen Chandy “without expecting positions or personal gains.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Responding to allegations concerning his family, Mr Unnithan asserted that his son had never joined the BJP. Taking an apparent dig at Padmaja Venugopal, he said it was “the children of those who had secured everything” within the Congress who had crossed over to the BJP.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Rift within Congress: Rajmohan Unnithan challenges Shafi Parambil to public debate, warns ‘teacher and disciple will be exposed’

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:13:49 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Unnithan said he was ‘ready to end his political career' if Shafi Parambil could prove that his allegations were baseless

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Intensifying the internal conflict within the Congress in Keralam, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan on Tuesday launched a sharp attack on fellow party leader Shafi Parambil, MP, alleging that a coordinated cyber campaign was being orchestrated against him and warning that he would expose those behind it if the attacks continued. Challenging Mr. Parambil to an open public debate, Mr Unnithan said he was “ready to end his political career” if Mr Parambil could prove that his allegations were baseless. He also claimed that he had recorded all relevant details in his personal diary and warned that the people involved, whom he described as “the teacher and the disciple”, would eventually be exposed. Mr Unnithan dismissed the claim that Mr. Parambil belonged to the ‘A’ group in the Congress, saying it would be “the eighth wonder of the world” to describe him as an A group leader. He clarified that he had not insulted Mr Parambil but had only stated that he did not belong to the group. Taking aim at those invoking the legacy of the late former Chief Minister Oommen Chandy, Mr Unnithan said many Congress leaders had stayed away when Chandy was being targeted, while others were concerned about protecting the public image. He questioned where those now speaking about the “Oommen Chandy school of politics” had been at the time. He also maintained that he had not received any personal benefits in Chandy’s name. Mr Unnithan alleged that the social media attacks against him were being conducted through fake accounts as part of a deliberate campaign rather than being spontaneous criticism. He claimed that the operation was being “controlled from Adoor and from a particular house.” Referring to a flat in Panampilly Nagar and a vehicle bearing the registration number 20-20, he hinted that he possessed information about those involved but declined to disclose further details immediately. “Everything is in my diary, the teacher and the disciple will both be trapped,” he warned, adding that he should not be unnecessarily provoked. He warned that if forced to reveal everything, “the respectable public image of certain people will be torn apart.” Mr Unnithan said he had always been “a lone fighter” within the party and had stood with former Congress leader K Karunakaran and Oommen Chandy “without expecting positions or personal gains.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Responding to allegations concerning his family, Mr Unnithan asserted that his son had never joined the BJP. Taking an apparent dig at Padmaja Venugopal, he said it was “the children of those who had secured everything” within the Congress who had crossed over to the BJP.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Intensifying the internal conflict within the Congress in Keralam, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan on Tuesday launched a sharp attack on fellow party leader Shafi Parambil, MP, alleging that a coordinated cyber campaign was being orchestrated against him and warning that he would expose those behind it if the attacks continued. Challenging Mr. Parambil to an open public debate, Mr Unnithan said he was “ready to end his political career” if Mr Parambil could prove that his allegations were baseless. He also claimed that he had recorded all relevant details in his personal diary and warned that the people involved, whom he described as “the teacher and the disciple”, would eventually be exposed. Mr Unnithan dismissed the claim that Mr. Parambil belonged to the ‘A’ group in the Congress, saying it would be “the eighth wonder of the world” to describe him as an A group leader. He clarified that he had not insulted Mr Parambil but had only stated that he did not belong to the group. Taking aim at those invoking the legacy of the late former Chief Minister Oommen Chandy, Mr Unnithan said many Congress leaders had stayed away when Chandy was being targeted, while others were concerned about protecting the public image. He questioned where those now speaking about the “Oommen Chandy school of politics” had been at the time. He also maintained that he had not received any personal benefits in Chandy’s name. Mr Unnithan alleged that the social media attacks against him were being conducted through fake accounts as part of a deliberate campaign rather than being spontaneous criticism. He claimed that the operation was being “controlled from Adoor and from a particular house.” Referring to a flat in Panampilly Nagar and a vehicle bearing the registration number 20-20, he hinted that he possessed information about those involved but declined to disclose further details immediately. “Everything is in my diary, the teacher and the disciple will both be trapped,” he warned, adding that he should not be unnecessarily provoked. He warned that if forced to reveal everything, “the respectable public image of certain people will be torn apart.” Mr Unnithan said he had always been “a lone fighter” within the party and had stood with former Congress leader K Karunakaran and Oommen Chandy “without expecting positions or personal gains.”
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Responding to allegations concerning his family, Mr Unnithan asserted that his son had never joined the BJP. Taking an apparent dig at Padmaja Venugopal, he said it was “the children of those who had secured everything” within the Congress who had crossed over to the BJP.

articles.title: After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal announce alliance for Punjab Assembly election
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hails the move as ‘putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Six years after parting ways because of differences over the three farm laws, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dali (SAD ), reunited ahead of the Assembly election in Punjab, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailing the move as “putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first”. The announcement of the return of the SAD to the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) headed by the BJP was made at a press conference held at the BJP’s headquarters in New Delhi, and addressed by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal, and BJP president Nitin Nabin. Seat adjustment details are yet to be ironed out, according to Mr. Nabin, who said talks in this regard were ongoing, while Mr. Shah clarified that the SAD would continue to hold the status of “elder brother” or the more dominant partner in the State, with a claim to the Chief Minister’s post if the alliance came to power. “It is usually the elder brother who has a claim to the CM’s post,” Mr. Shah said. The alliance’s goal was to make Punjab drug-free by December 31, 2029, and make sure that law and order, development, and issues pertaining to farmers were addressed, the Home Minister also said. Mr. Badal hailed the long history and personal equations between senior leaders of the BJP, the late former PM Atal Behari Vajpayee and L.K. Advani, with his own father, late CM of Punjab, Parkash Singh Badal, who had, between the three of them, fashioned the alliance in 1996. “This is not a political alliance; it’s an alliance of people’s sentiments,” Mr. Sukhbir Badal said, emphasising Hindu- Sikh unity and harmony, as did Mr. Nabin in his remarks. The PM would be attending a public meeting in Moga on December 8, Mr. Sukhbir Badal said, marking the birth anniversary of Parkash Singh Badal. VIDEO | Delhi: During a joint press conference, Union Home Minister Amit Shah (@AmitShah) says, "BJP, the Akali Dal, and the NDA will contest in Punjab, and we will announce several key points in our manifesto. But, I want to make one thing very clear: eliminating drugs from Punjab will be our primary goal, eliminating corruption in Punjab will be our primary goal, and strengthening nationalist forces in Punjab will also be our primary goal. The current government in the state, led by Kejriwal Ji, had come to power promising to eliminate drugs within three months. They promised to eliminate drugs, but the problem has not been eradicated; it has increased. In 2017, Rahul Gandhi Ji had promised that drugs would be eliminated within one term. He made that promise, but his party also did nothing to address the drug problem. Now, I want to reiterate a promise that I made there: by December 31, 2029, we will make Punjab completely drug-free." (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) While the contours of the exact seat-sharing agreement are yet to be decided, in the past, the BJP contested 23 out of the 117 seats in the fray, a situation that is likely to change, with the BJP being given more seats, albeit still fewer than the SAD. The alliance had won 93 seats in the 1997 Assembly election, with the SAD winning 75 seats and the BJP winning 18 seats. After losing power to the Congress in 2002, the alliance returned to office in 2007 with 68 seats and retained power in 2012 with an identical tally, bucking Punjab’s trend of voting out incumbent governments.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SAD walked away from the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Badal also resigning her position as Minister in the Modi government at the Centre over the three farm laws that sought to re-engineer agri-commerce, igniting months-long protests on Delhi’s borders. To a question by the media on what the SAD had to say about the farm laws now, Mr. Shah answered that since the farm Bills had been withdrawn by the government, “there is no point in asking the question”.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal announce alliance for Punjab Assembly election

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:12:09 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hails the move as ‘putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Six years after parting ways because of differences over the three farm laws, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dali (SAD ), reunited ahead of the Assembly election in Punjab, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailing the move as “putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first”. The announcement of the return of the SAD to the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) headed by the BJP was made at a press conference held at the BJP’s headquarters in New Delhi, and addressed by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal, and BJP president Nitin Nabin. Seat adjustment details are yet to be ironed out, according to Mr. Nabin, who said talks in this regard were ongoing, while Mr. Shah clarified that the SAD would continue to hold the status of “elder brother” or the more dominant partner in the State, with a claim to the Chief Minister’s post if the alliance came to power. “It is usually the elder brother who has a claim to the CM’s post,” Mr. Shah said. The alliance’s goal was to make Punjab drug-free by December 31, 2029, and make sure that law and order, development, and issues pertaining to farmers were addressed, the Home Minister also said. Mr. Badal hailed the long history and personal equations between senior leaders of the BJP, the late former PM Atal Behari Vajpayee and L.K. Advani, with his own father, late CM of Punjab, Parkash Singh Badal, who had, between the three of them, fashioned the alliance in 1996. “This is not a political alliance; it’s an alliance of people’s sentiments,” Mr. Sukhbir Badal said, emphasising Hindu- Sikh unity and harmony, as did Mr. Nabin in his remarks. The PM would be attending a public meeting in Moga on December 8, Mr. Sukhbir Badal said, marking the birth anniversary of Parkash Singh Badal. VIDEO | Delhi: During a joint press conference, Union Home Minister Amit Shah (@AmitShah) says, "BJP, the Akali Dal, and the NDA will contest in Punjab, and we will announce several key points in our manifesto. But, I want to make one thing very clear: eliminating drugs from Punjab will be our primary goal, eliminating corruption in Punjab will be our primary goal, and strengthening nationalist forces in Punjab will also be our primary goal. The current government in the state, led by Kejriwal Ji, had come to power promising to eliminate drugs within three months. They promised to eliminate drugs, but the problem has not been eradicated; it has increased. In 2017, Rahul Gandhi Ji had promised that drugs would be eliminated within one term. He made that promise, but his party also did nothing to address the drug problem. Now, I want to reiterate a promise that I made there: by December 31, 2029, we will make Punjab completely drug-free." (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) While the contours of the exact seat-sharing agreement are yet to be decided, in the past, the BJP contested 23 out of the 117 seats in the fray, a situation that is likely to change, with the BJP being given more seats, albeit still fewer than the SAD. The alliance had won 93 seats in the 1997 Assembly election, with the SAD winning 75 seats and the BJP winning 18 seats. After losing power to the Congress in 2002, the alliance returned to office in 2007 with 68 seats and retained power in 2012 with an identical tally, bucking Punjab’s trend of voting out incumbent governments.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SAD walked away from the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Badal also resigning her position as Minister in the Modi government at the Centre over the three farm laws that sought to re-engineer agri-commerce, igniting months-long protests on Delhi’s borders. To a question by the media on what the SAD had to say about the farm laws now, Mr. Shah answered that since the farm Bills had been withdrawn by the government, “there is no point in asking the question”.

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal announce alliance for Punjab Assembly election", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Prime Minister Narendra Modi hails the move as ‘putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first’.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal announc' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal anno' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal anno' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Prime Minister Narendra Modi hails the move as ‘putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first’." (Hinglish Arth: प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने इस कदम को 'पंजाब और पंजाबियों के कल्याण को पहले स्थान पर रखने' वाला कदम बताया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "After six years apart, BJP and Akali Dal announce alliance for Punjab Assembly election"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Shah answered that since the farm Bills had been withdrawn by the government, “there is no point in asking the question”.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Shah answered that since the farm Bills had been withdrawn by the government, “there is no point in asking the question”." (Hinglish Arth: शाह ने जवाब दिया कि चूंकि सरकार ने कृषि बिल वापस ले लिया है, इसलिए "सवाल पूछने का कोई मतलब नहीं है"।)

articles.title: Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Tamil Nadu BJP chief arrested, tight security in hillock on Karthigai Deepam day
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: All eyes are on Thirupparankundram on the day of Karthigai Deepam festival on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) following the Supreme Court's recent interim order allowing lighting of lamp on the controversial 'deepathoon' atop the hill in Madurai district.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Former Union Minister and BJP leader L. Murugan who was stopped by the police near the Annur bus stop in Coimbatore district, questioned the imposition of restrictions on his movement in Coimbatore district when the prohibitory orders were applicable to Madurai district. Speaking to reporters, Mr. Murugan said: “There is no relevance to the prohibitory orders imposed in Madurai to restrict movement in Coimbatore district. The police have not given me proper information or explained the reason for stopping me,” he said on Tuesday — T.C. Sibi Sreevathson Nainar Nagenthran, who left his home in Tirunelveli district at 2.35 pm for Thirupparankundram, was arrested at Thatchanallur check-post on Tirunelveli City outskirts at 3.15 pm along with a group of party functionaries. Police team led by Assistant Commissioner of Police, Palayamkottai, Rajamurali Ramachandran has been deployed in front of the house of Mr. Nagenthran to stop him from going to Thirupparankundram to participate in Karthigai Deepam festival. Here’s a look at the history and legal background of this long-running dispute. When a row broke out over lighting of Karthigai Deepam at the hill in Madurai, four Sthaneeka Bhattars of the Subramaniaswami Temple testified that the lamp had been lit at the Uchipillaiyar Temple since “time immemorial” The Bhattars conveyed this in a communication written to the temple authorities against the backdrop of a raging row over the Hindu Munnani’s demand for lighting the deepam at a different place. Explore the 30-year-old controversy over Karthigai Deepam lighting at Thirupparankundram, featuring testimonies from Sthaneeka Bhattars. In Thirupparankundram in Madurai, Hindus and Muslims live in camaraderie, but that has not kept the hill, which holds a couple of temples, a dargah, and some Jain beds, out of dispute. Here, we outline the history of judgments involving different petitioners through the years, in an attempt to understand the current crisis.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Explore the legal and political tensions in Thirupparankundram, where communal harmony faces challenges over religious practices and land disputes.

articles.title: Sonia Gandhi recalls ‘pull of power’ while deciding against becoming PM in 2004
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: She said it was a lesson about power that ‘once you have it, you may find excuses to keep it.’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi has said she felt the "pull of power" while deciding on whether she should take up the prime ministership in 2004, as she thought that she owed it to party workers who had rallied across the country during the election campaign to accept the post. She said it was a lesson about power that "once you have it, you may find excuses to keep it". The observations came during a conversation with her son Rahul Gandhi and daughter Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, a video of which was shared by them on social media platforms. In the video shared days after the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir 'Belonging: A Journey Of Love' , the three are seen reminiscing about moments of joy, laughter and pain they felt at various points in time. In a post on X, Rahul Gandhi shared the video and said, "Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage." The proposal didn't go according to plan and neither did my seventh birthday. The decision in 2004 gave some of us relief but others joy. There was an intention behind withdrawing Papa's security. And even after 500+ pages there are some things Ma has left out of her book. Priyanka and I sat down with our mother to talk through all of it. Going back to those memories brought back the joy, the laughter and even the pain we felt at the time. Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage. In the video, Sonia Gandhi talks in detail about the internal conflict she faced while deciding whether to take up the Prime Minister's post after the Congress-led UPA's victory in the 2004 Lok Sabha elections. She asserts that she did not want power. Talking about the time, Rahul Gandhi says there was a situation unfolding and "we were witnessing the situation from the inside". "On the one hand there was mum saying maybe, maybe not. On the other side there were seven people. There is one gentleman over there who is the best possible PM," he recalls, referring to Manmohan Singh.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "The interesting thing is there is only one man who can be PM because of his qualities, capabilities, and there are six-seven dreamers who cannot be. Then my mother decides - 'No (not taking up premiership)'; there is actually joy in the room," he says.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Sonia Gandhi recalls ‘pull of power’ while deciding against becoming PM in 2004

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 05:10:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: She said it was a lesson about power that ‘once you have it, you may find excuses to keep it.’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi has said she felt the "pull of power" while deciding on whether she should take up the prime ministership in 2004, as she thought that she owed it to party workers who had rallied across the country during the election campaign to accept the post. She said it was a lesson about power that "once you have it, you may find excuses to keep it". The observations came during a conversation with her son Rahul Gandhi and daughter Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, a video of which was shared by them on social media platforms. In the video shared days after the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir 'Belonging: A Journey Of Love' , the three are seen reminiscing about moments of joy, laughter and pain they felt at various points in time. In a post on X, Rahul Gandhi shared the video and said, "Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage." The proposal didn't go according to plan and neither did my seventh birthday. The decision in 2004 gave some of us relief but others joy. There was an intention behind withdrawing Papa's security. And even after 500+ pages there are some things Ma has left out of her book. Priyanka and I sat down with our mother to talk through all of it. Going back to those memories brought back the joy, the laughter and even the pain we felt at the time. Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage. In the video, Sonia Gandhi talks in detail about the internal conflict she faced while deciding whether to take up the Prime Minister's post after the Congress-led UPA's victory in the 2004 Lok Sabha elections. She asserts that she did not want power. Talking about the time, Rahul Gandhi says there was a situation unfolding and "we were witnessing the situation from the inside". "On the one hand there was mum saying maybe, maybe not. On the other side there were seven people. There is one gentleman over there who is the best possible PM," he recalls, referring to Manmohan Singh.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "The interesting thing is there is only one man who can be PM because of his qualities, capabilities, and there are six-seven dreamers who cannot be. Then my mother decides - 'No (not taking up premiership)'; there is actually joy in the room," he says.
