hinglishTracks.en: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who challenged their deletion, some of whom said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — द हिंदू ने बेंगलुरु में कई लोगों से बात की जिन्होंने अपने विलोपन को चुनौती दी थी, जिनमें से कुछ ने कहा कि जब उन्होंने अपील के माध्यम से अपने विलोपन को वापस लेने की मांग की तो अधिकारियों ने उनकी ओर से फॉर्म 6 आवेदन जमा किए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the final electoral rolls from the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) were published, several people whose names had been deleted challenged their exclusion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) से अंतिम मतदाता सूची प्रकाशित होने के बाद, कई लोगों जिनके नाम हटा दिए गए थे, ने अपने बहिष्कार को चुनौती दी।।

hinglishTracks.en: They argued that they were left out despite having completed the entire process, including attending hearings and submitting the required documents.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि सुनवाई में भाग लेने और आवश्यक दस्तावेज जमा करने सहित पूरी प्रक्रिया पूरी करने के बावजूद उन्हें छोड़ दिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: More than 350 appeals have been filed across Karnataka so far.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पूरे कर्नाटक में अब तक 350 से अधिक अपीलें दायर की जा चुकी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Deputy Commissioner or District Election Officer (DEO) serves as the first appellate authority in the SIR, while the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) is the second and final appellate authority if the first-stage response is unsatisfactory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यदि प्रथम चरण की प्रतिक्रिया असंतोषजनक है तो उपायुक्त या जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारी (डीईओ) एसआईआर में प्रथम अपीलीय प्राधिकारी के रूप में कार्य करते हैं, जबकि मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी (सीईओ) दूसरे और अंतिम अपीलीय प्राधिकारी होते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the CEO’s office, all appeals received so far remain pending or have been disposed of at the first appellate stage.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सीईओ कार्यालय के अनुसार, अब तक प्राप्त सभी अपीलें लंबित हैं या प्रथम अपीलीय चरण में उनका निपटारा कर दिया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who have challenged their deletion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — द हिंदू ने बेंगलुरु में कई लोगों से बात की जिन्होंने खुद को हटाए जाने को चुनौती दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: While some said officials advised them to withdraw their appeals and apply afresh through Form 6, others said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जबकि कुछ अधिकारियों ने उन्हें अपनी अपील वापस लेने और फॉर्म 6 के माध्यम से नए सिरे से आवेदन करने की सलाह दी, वहीं अन्य ने कहा कि जब उन्होंने अपील के माध्यम से अपने विलोपन को वापस लेने की मांग की तो अधिकारियों ने अपनी ओर से फॉर्म 6 आवेदन जमा कर दिए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: A few of them said they had since received an Elector’s Photo Identity Card (EPIC) and were told that their names would figure in a supplementary list.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उनमें से कुछ ने कहा कि उन्हें निर्वाचक फोटो पहचान पत्र (ईपीआईसी) प्राप्त हो गया है और उन्हें बताया गया है कि उनके नाम पूरक सूची में शामिल होंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: While Form 6 applications are accepted throughout the year as part of the ECI’s “continuous updation” process, this route could leave those excluded from the SIR rolls unable to vote in the upcoming local body elections, including the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) elections.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जबकि ईसीआई की "निरंतर अद्यतन" प्रक्रिया के हिस्से के रूप में फॉर्म 6 आवेदन पूरे वर्ष स्वीकार किए जाते हैं, यह मार्ग एसआईआर रोल से बाहर किए गए लोगों को ग्रेटर बेंगलुरु अथॉरिटी (जीबीए) चुनावों सहित आगामी स्थानीय निकाय चुनावों में मतदान करने में असमर्थ बना सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Continuous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Continuous' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The GBA elections have been directed to be conducted using the SIR final rolls by December, before even the summary revision process begins or a supplementary list is published.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जीबीए चुनाव को सारांश संशोधन प्रक्रिया शुरू होने या पूरक सूची प्रकाशित होने से पहले दिसंबर तक एसआईआर अंतिम रोल का उपयोग करके आयोजित करने का निर्देश दिया गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Those who have appealed argue that they are not new voters seeking fresh inclusion, but people who have been voting from the same addresses and were wrongly deleted.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अपील करने वालों का तर्क है कि वे नए मतदाता नहीं हैं जो नए सिरे से शामिल होने की मांग कर रहे हैं, बल्कि वे लोग हैं जो एक ही पते से मतदान कर रहे थे और गलत तरीके से हटा दिए गए थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: They also questioned why they should be asked to make a declaration through Form 6 that does not reflect their circumstances, when they had already submitted documents to address the discrepancies flagged during the SIR.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने यह भी सवाल किया कि उन्हें फॉर्म 6 के माध्यम से एक घोषणा करने के लिए क्यों कहा जाना चाहिए जो उनकी परिस्थितियों को प्रतिबिंबित नहीं करता है, जबकि उन्होंने एसआईआर के दौरान चिह्नित विसंगतियों को संबोधित करने के लिए पहले ही दस्तावेज जमा कर दिए थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Declaration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Declaration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Iqbal, a resident of Sarjapura, told The Hindu that he received a notice over “no mapping.” He had mapped his father’s details, whose name is on the electoral roll in Bihar,but his name was still flagged.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सरजापुरा के निवासी इकबाल ने द हिंदू को बताया कि उन्हें "नो मैपिंग" पर नोटिस मिला है। उन्होंने अपने पिता का विवरण मैप किया था, जिनका नाम बिहार में मतदाता सूची में है, लेकिन उनका नाम अभी भी चिह्नित किया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Iqbal said that although he had shifted his residence within the city more than five years ago, his EPIC had been updated and he had submitted the required documents.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इकबाल ने कहा कि हालांकि उन्होंने पांच साल से अधिक समय पहले शहर के भीतर अपना निवास स्थान बदल लिया था, लेकिन उनका ईपीआईसी अपडेट हो गया था और उन्होंने आवश्यक दस्तावेज जमा कर दिए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: His name was deleted from the final SIR rolls after figuring in the draft list.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ड्राफ्ट सूची में नाम आने के बाद उनका नाम अंतिम एसआईआर रोल से हटा दिया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Several people also said that while the names of all members of their families figured in the draft rolls, some were deleted from the final list.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कई लोगों ने यह भी कहा कि उनके परिवार के सभी सदस्यों के नाम ड्राफ्ट रोल में थे, लेकिन कुछ को अंतिम सूची से हटा दिया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: They argued that even when appeals were disposed of, the outcomes were not uniform within families.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि जब अपीलों का निपटारा किया गया, तब भी परिवारों के भीतर परिणाम एक समान नहीं थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Sahiba, a resident of Jayanagar, said she was flagged over an anomaly indicating that the age gap between two children was less than nine months.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जयनगर की रहने वाली साहिबा ने कहा कि उन्हें एक विसंगति के बारे में बताया गया था जिसमें बताया गया था कि दो बच्चों के बीच उम्र का अंतर नौ महीने से कम है।।

hinglishTracks.en: She has twins and submitted their birth certificates to establish this.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उसके जुड़वाँ बच्चे हैं और इसे स्थापित करने के लिए उन्होंने उनके जन्म प्रमाण पत्र जमा किये हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, officials subsequently raised a discrepancy in her mother’s name across records.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 SIR: Voters in Karnataka challenge deletions, say officials asking them to withdraw appeals, file Form 6

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:11:33 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who challenged their deletion, some of whom said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: After the final electoral rolls from the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) were published, several people whose names had been deleted challenged their exclusion. They argued that they were left out despite having completed the entire process, including attending hearings and submitting the required documents. More than 350 appeals have been filed across Karnataka so far. The Deputy Commissioner or District Election Officer (DEO) serves as the first appellate authority in the SIR, while the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) is the second and final appellate authority if the first-stage response is unsatisfactory. According to the CEO’s office, all appeals received so far remain pending or have been disposed of at the first appellate stage. The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who have challenged their deletion. While some said officials advised them to withdraw their appeals and apply afresh through Form 6, others said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal. A few of them said they had since received an Elector’s Photo Identity Card (EPIC) and were told that their names would figure in a supplementary list. While Form 6 applications are accepted throughout the year as part of the ECI’s “continuous updation” process, this route could leave those excluded from the SIR rolls unable to vote in the upcoming local body elections, including the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) elections. The GBA elections have been directed to be conducted using the SIR final rolls by December, before even the summary revision process begins or a supplementary list is published. Those who have appealed argue that they are not new voters seeking fresh inclusion, but people who have been voting from the same addresses and were wrongly deleted. They also questioned why they should be asked to make a declaration through Form 6 that does not reflect their circumstances, when they had already submitted documents to address the discrepancies flagged during the SIR. Iqbal, a resident of Sarjapura, told The Hindu that he received a notice over “no mapping.” He had mapped his father’s details, whose name is on the electoral roll in Bihar,but his name was still flagged. Mr. Iqbal said that although he had shifted his residence within the city more than five years ago, his EPIC had been updated and he had submitted the required documents. His name was deleted from the final SIR rolls after figuring in the draft list. Several people also said that while the names of all members of their families figured in the draft rolls, some were deleted from the final list. They argued that even when appeals were disposed of, the outcomes were not uniform within families.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sahiba, a resident of Jayanagar, said she was flagged over an anomaly indicating that the age gap between two children was less than nine months. She has twins and submitted their birth certificates to establish this. However, officials subsequently raised a discrepancy in her mother’s name across records. “I explained that it was the same person and that only the spelling had changed during translation. I submitted all my documents as well as my mother’s. But I was then questioned about why I had mapped to my mother and not my father or husband. Both my father and husband are in Saudi Arabia and were not part of the 2002 rolls. Now the officials are telling me to withdraw my appeal and file Form 6,” she said.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.

articles.title: Police in Karnataka prevent Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee chief Y.S. Sharmila from entering disputed property
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli. Ms. Sharmila was stopped by the police at Bagalur Road in Yelahanka while she was travelling towards Yelahanka Palace at Kattigenahalli village in Jala hobli, Bengaluru North taluk. She had arrived at Bengaluru airport from Hyderabad and was proceeding by road to the property. She reportedly intended to visit the bungalow along with her mother, Y.S. Vijayalakshmi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police informed Ms. Sharmila about the interim injunction order, which restrains her from entering the disputed property. The court order also prohibits her family members, agents, representatives and anyone acting on her behalf from obstructing or interfering with the property.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Police in Karnataka prevent Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee chief Y.S. Sharmila from entering disputed property

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:09:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The North East Division police of Bengaluru on Sunday stopped Y.S. Sharmila, president of the Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) and sister of YSRCP chief and former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli. Ms. Sharmila was stopped by the police at Bagalur Road in Yelahanka while she was travelling towards Yelahanka Palace at Kattigenahalli village in Jala hobli, Bengaluru North taluk. She had arrived at Bengaluru airport from Hyderabad and was proceeding by road to the property. She reportedly intended to visit the bungalow along with her mother, Y.S. Vijayalakshmi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police informed Ms. Sharmila about the interim injunction order, which restrains her from entering the disputed property. The court order also prohibits her family members, agents, representatives and anyone acting on her behalf from obstructing or interfering with the property.

articles.title: Wanted man held after 14 months for mob attack on Delhi police team in Chhatarpur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, police said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 20-year-old man wanted in connection with a mob attack on police personnel in south Delhi’s Chhatarpur, in which four policemen were injured, has been arrested from Rajasthan after evading arrest for over 14 months, police said on Sunday (November 22, 2026) The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, following a tip-off received two days earlier, police said. According to the police, the incident took place on September 15, 2025, when a police team performing official duties in Chandan Holla village was attacked by a mob armed with bricks, sticks and stones. Four police personnel sustained injuries in the attack, while the mob also obstructed the team from carrying out its duties. An FIR was registered at Fatehpur Beri police station on September 16, 2025, under sections 221, 132, 121(1), 110, 351(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police said a team of the Special Staff developed the intelligence input about Khan’s whereabouts and conducted an operation in Bhiwadi to apprehend him. He was subsequently brought to Delhi and arrested on November 20 in connection with the case.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police said the accused had no previous criminal involvement. Further investigation remains under way.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Wanted man held after 14 months for mob attack on Delhi police team in Chhatarpur

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 02:11:35 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, police said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 20-year-old man wanted in connection with a mob attack on police personnel in south Delhi’s Chhatarpur, in which four policemen were injured, has been arrested from Rajasthan after evading arrest for over 14 months, police said on Sunday (November 22, 2026) The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, following a tip-off received two days earlier, police said. According to the police, the incident took place on September 15, 2025, when a police team performing official duties in Chandan Holla village was attacked by a mob armed with bricks, sticks and stones. Four police personnel sustained injuries in the attack, while the mob also obstructed the team from carrying out its duties. An FIR was registered at Fatehpur Beri police station on September 16, 2025, under sections 221, 132, 121(1), 110, 351(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police said a team of the Special Staff developed the intelligence input about Khan’s whereabouts and conducted an operation in Bhiwadi to apprehend him. He was subsequently brought to Delhi and arrested on November 20 in connection with the case.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The police said the accused had no previous criminal involvement. Further investigation remains under way.

articles.title: Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers. Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification, and he claimed that a Minister from Maharashtra has taken responsibility for the situation and promised to provide funds for the purpose, further alleging that the government has delayed the session of the Parliament because it does not concern itself with the nation, the Constitution, or the Parliament, adding that if parties do not defect, MPs would be purchased, and he referenced a statement regarding a rate on an exchange of ₹150 crore per MP.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers. Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification, and he claimed that a Minister from Maharashtra has taken responsibility for the situation and promised to provide funds for the purpose, further alleging that the government has delayed the session of the Parliament because it does not concern itself with the nation, the Constitution, or the Parliament, adding that if parties do not defect, MPs would be purchased, and he referenced a statement regarding a rate on an exchange of ₹150 crore per MP.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance

articles.title: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. They said that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, they said. The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters. Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime dictator Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011. A UN-supported government is based in Tripoli, and a rival administration is located in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West. The eastern Libya-based government said in a statement that the strike on Sunday (November 22) caused an explosion and fire at the base, which was later extinguished. The Almasar satellite television channel aired footage showing a vessel erupting into flames. It said the Libyan navy rescued the crew of the Maltese-flagged ship. A corvette is a warship smaller than a frigate or destroyer and is built to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships. The vessel had docked at the Libyan base for refuelling and supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said, without providing details on the vessel or its cargo. A joint investigation was launched with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it,” the statement said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. There was no immediate comment from either Russia or Ukraine.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 06:32:56 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. They said that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, they said. The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters. Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime dictator Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011. A UN-supported government is based in Tripoli, and a rival administration is located in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West. The eastern Libya-based government said in a statement that the strike on Sunday (November 22) caused an explosion and fire at the base, which was later extinguished. The Almasar satellite television channel aired footage showing a vessel erupting into flames. It said the Libyan navy rescued the crew of the Maltese-flagged ship. A corvette is a warship smaller than a frigate or destroyer and is built to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships. The vessel had docked at the Libyan base for refuelling and supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said, without providing details on the vessel or its cargo. A joint investigation was launched with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it,” the statement said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. There was no immediate comment from either Russia or Ukraine.

articles.title: Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. Ms. Mejia's husband was accompanying Ms. Mejia and her father when they were detained Saturday (November 21), Ms. Catala added. The husband was not detained, the attorney said. “They've done everything correctly, and these are educated people," Ms. Catala said of the father and daughter. "She went to college, to university; she worked for a nonprofit. No criminal history [for] any of them. So it's just heartbreaking.” Both were being held at the Northwest ICE Processing Centre in Tacoma, Ms. Catala said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She said Ms. Mejia was carrying a cup of coffee when the confrontation occurred.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:37:05 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. Ms. Mejia's husband was accompanying Ms. Mejia and her father when they were detained Saturday (November 21), Ms. Catala added. The husband was not detained, the attorney said. “They've done everything correctly, and these are educated people," Ms. Catala said of the father and daughter. "She went to college, to university; she worked for a nonprofit. No criminal history [for] any of them. So it's just heartbreaking.” Both were being held at the Northwest ICE Processing Centre in Tacoma, Ms. Catala said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She said Ms. Mejia was carrying a cup of coffee when the confrontation occurred.

articles.title: Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Ben-Gvir replied in an X post that Mr. Eisenkot’s condemnation amounted to selling out to Arab parties, which could become part of a possible new government. Mr. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 03:32:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Ben-Gvir replied in an X post that Mr. Eisenkot’s condemnation amounted to selling out to Arab parties, which could become part of a possible new government. Mr. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Inconclusive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inconclusive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewi' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by J' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by J' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional..." (Hinglish Arth: गादी ईसेनकोट ने हमलों को 'यहूदी आतंकवाद' कहा, उन्होंने कहा कि 'वाहनों और घरों में आग लगाने वाले चरमपंथी समूह क्षेत्रीय स्थिरता को कमजोर कर रहे हैं, जीवन को खतरे में डाल रहे हैं और इजरायल के राष्ट्र को गंभीर नुकसान पहुंचा रहे हैं।')
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank." articles.title: Central California concert shooting: Nine people shot; one in critical condition
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Authorities said that they believe the shooting ‘may be gang-related’ but didn’t elaborate

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nine people were shot at a concert in central California, leaving one person critically injured with a chest injury, the local sheriff said Sunday (November 22). The shooting broke out around 7:30 p.m. Saturday (November 21) at a concert attended by about 150 people in Strathmore, a small town in Tulare County, a mountainous region in the centre of the state, the county sheriff's department said in a statement. An unspecified number of suspects opened fire on the crowd. No arrests were announced. One 26-year-old man was shot in the chest and required surgery. He remained in critical condition, the sheriff's department said. Two other victims, ages 19 and 22, also required surgery, while six people sustained minor injuries. Authorities said that they believe the shooting “may be gang-related” but didn't elaborate. The show in the town of roughly 3,000 people featured performers from neighbouring states, the department said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The department didn't immediately respond to emailed questions seeking further details but said there was no longer any immediate threat to the public.

articles.title: Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q1 • Central Inference & Passage Core
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
options: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S.
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Scientists report strong new evidence that speci' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Scientists report strong new evidence that sp' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'Scientists report strong new evidence that sp' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S." (Hinglish Arth: नवीनतम शोध तब आया है जब फ्लोरिडा असामान्य रूप से बड़े पैमाने पर वायरस के प्रकोप से जूझ रहा है, जो किसी भी यू.एस. में सबसे बड़ा प्रतीत होता है।)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus." (Hinglish Arth: शोधकर्ताओं ने डेंगू, चिकनगुनिया या जीका वायरस के लक्षणों के लिए रक्त का परीक्षण किया।)

hinglishTracks.en: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नवीनतम शोध तब आया है जब फ्लोरिडा असामान्य रूप से बड़े पैमाने पर वायरस के प्रकोप से जूझ रहा है, जो किसी भी यू.एस. में सबसे बड़ा प्रतीत होता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: state since at least the 1940s
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कम से कम 1940 के दशक से राज्य।

hinglishTracks.en: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — शोधकर्ताओं ने शनिवार को बताया कि जो बच्चे ब्राजील के पड़ोस में एक विशेष प्रकार के मच्छरों से गुलजार रहते हैं, उनमें डेंगू या किसी अन्य चिंताजनक वायरस, चिकनगुनिया से संक्रमित होने की संभावना बहुत कम थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दुनिया के डेंगू हॉटस्पॉट में से एक में 5,700 से अधिक बच्चों का प्रमुख अध्ययन नए सबूत पेश करता है कि इन वायरस को प्रसारित करने में असमर्थ मच्छरों को प्रजनन करना केवल कीटनाशकों पर निर्भर रहने और काटे जाने से बचने की कोशिश करने के बजाय एक व्यवहार्य रणनीति हो सकती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इन तथाकथित वोल्बाचिया-वाहक मच्छरों द्वारा आबादी वाले पड़ोस में, शोधकर्ताओं ने पाया कि समान पड़ोस की तुलना में स्कूली बच्चों में डेंगू और चिकनगुनिया संक्रमण में 69% की कमी आई है - यह प्रभाव ब्राजील के गंभीर 2024 डेंगू प्रकोप के दौरान भी कायम रहा, डॉ. ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एमोरी विश्वविद्यालय के श्री एडुपुगांती, अंतरराष्ट्रीय शोध टीम का हिस्सा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शोधकर्ताओं ने अमेरिकन सोसाइटी ऑफ ट्रॉपिकल मेडिसिन एंड हाइजीन की एक बैठक में निष्कर्षों की सूचना दी।।

hinglishTracks.en: “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — "यह वास्तव में रोमांचक है," बोस्टन विश्वविद्यालय के वैश्विक स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ डेविड हैमर ने कहा, जो ब्राजीलियाई अध्ययन में शामिल नहीं थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उनका अनुमान है कि मच्छर जनित बीमारी से लड़ने के लिए मौजूदा कदमों के साथ इन वोल्बाचिया मच्छरों का अधिक उपयोग करने से कई स्थानों पर "डेंगू को बहुत निचले स्तर तक कम किया जा सकता है"।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नवीनतम शोध तब आया है जब फ्लोरिडा असामान्य रूप से बड़े पैमाने पर वायरस के प्रकोप से जूझ रहा है, जो किसी भी यू.एस. में सबसे बड़ा प्रतीत होता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: state since at least the 1940s.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कम से कम 1940 के दशक से राज्य।।

hinglishTracks.en: Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आमतौर पर महाद्वीपीय अमेरिका में, डेंगू ज्यादातर अंतरराष्ट्रीय यात्रा करने वाले लोगों में पाया जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन शुक्रवार तक, फ्लोरिडा के स्वास्थ्य अधिकारियों ने 650 से अधिक स्थानीय रूप से प्राप्त मामलों की गिनती की थी, उनमें से लगभग तीन-चौथाई टाम्पा के गृह हिल्सबोरो काउंटी में थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अमेरिका के बाहर, गैर-लाभकारी विश्व मच्छर कार्यक्रम ने वोल्बाचिया रणनीति की शुरुआत की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह कैसे काम करता है: वैज्ञानिक वोल्बाचिया नामक एक प्रकार के बैक्टीरिया को ले जाने के लिए मच्छरों का प्रजनन करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह लोगों के लिए हानिरहित है और कई कीड़ों में आम है, हालांकि डेंगू फैलाने वाले एडीज एजिप्टी मच्छर नहीं हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बैक्टीरिया मच्छरों की कुछ वायरस फैलाने की क्षमता को नाटकीय रूप से कम कर देते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मादा मच्छर अपनी संतानों में बैक्टीरिया फैलाती हैं, इसलिए विशेष रूप से पैदा किए गए पर्याप्त कीड़ों - नर और मादा - को एक क्षेत्र में छोड़ने से वोल्बाचिया धीरे-धीरे स्थानीय मच्छरों की आबादी में स्थापित हो जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इंडोनेशिया और अन्य जगहों पर फील्ड परीक्षणों और अन्य अध्ययनों से पता चला है कि रणनीति डेंगू के निदान को काफी कम कर सकती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लेकिन क्योंकि हल्के लक्षण वाले लोगों का निदान नहीं किया जा सकता है, बेलो होरिज़ोंटे, ब्राज़ील में नया अध्ययन आगे बढ़ गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — शोधकर्ताओं ने डेंगू, चिकनगुनिया या जीका वायरस के लक्षणों के लिए रक्त का परीक्षण किया।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:58:17 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):

जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Continental (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Continental' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

articles.title: No cluster kitchens for midday meals in Karnataka, says Education Minister Madhu Bangarappa
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Minister says that midday meal workers need not worry about their jobs

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minister for School Education and Literacy Madhu Bangarappa has assured that cluster kitchens (centralised cooking facilities) will not be established under the scheme providing midday meals to schoolchildren (Classes I to X) in the State. He said that midday meal workers need not worry about their jobs. On Monday, S. Balan, honorary president of Akshara Dasoha (Midday Meal Workers’ Union), met the Minister at his residence and submitted a list of demands, including not entertaining the idea of cluster kitchens. The delegation also sought a hike in monthly remuneration, citing the example of Keralam, where workers are paid ₹12,000, compared with ₹4,600 to ₹4,700 in Karnataka. Mr. Bangarappa said he would discuss the demand with the Chief Minister. “It is to our government’s credit that we previously raised the retirement corpus for midday meal workers to ₹40,000,” he said. He advised the union to meet Union government officials, noting that the midday meal scheme is not solely funded by the State government and involves participation from the Centre as well. Mr. Balan also raised concerns over substandard grains and rice being supplied to government schools to cook midday meals for children. The Minister sought precise details on where such incidents were occurring, promising strict action.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Minister outlining various demands, including the establishment of joint bank accounts for school headmasters and head cooks, a retirement corpus of at least ₹1 lakh, and a monthly pension of ₹5,000.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minister for School Education and Literacy Madhu Bangarappa has assured that cluster kitchens (centralised cooking facilities) will not be established under the scheme providing midday meals to schoolchildren (Classes I to X) in the State. He said that midday meal workers need not worry about their jobs. On Monday, S. Balan, honorary president of Akshara Dasoha (Midday Meal Workers’ Union), met the Minister at his residence and submitted a list of demands, including not entertaining the idea of cluster kitchens. The delegation also sought a hike in monthly remuneration, citing the example of Keralam, where workers are paid ₹12,000, compared with ₹4,600 to ₹4,700 in Karnataka. Mr. Bangarappa said he would discuss the demand with the Chief Minister. “It is to our government’s credit that we previously raised the retirement corpus for midday meal workers to ₹40,000,” he said. He advised the union to meet Union government officials, noting that the midday meal scheme is not solely funded by the State government and involves participation from the Centre as well. Mr. Balan also raised concerns over substandard grains and rice being supplied to government schools to cook midday meals for children. The Minister sought precise details on where such incidents were occurring, promising strict action.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Minister outlining various demands, including the establishment of joint bank accounts for school headmasters and head cooks, a retirement corpus of at least ₹1 lakh, and a monthly pension of ₹5,000.

articles.title: Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 was exposed on ECI citizen service portal, claims report
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While records going back to 2023 were verified for the report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For at least three years, the personal data that voters submitted to the Election Commission of India through Form 6, the application for registration as an elector, was exposed on its Citizen Service Portal (https://voters.eci.gov.in/ ) to anyone with a login, claims a report by ‘Charchagram’, a civic-tech initiative for building tools for enhancing transparency and accountability in public systems of India. It said that while records going back to 2023 were verified for this report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer. According to the report, using ECI published data, it estimates that at least seven crore Form 6 enrolments took place in this period. Each Form 6 application holds a citizen’s name, their relative’s name, gender, phone number, email, home address, photograph, Aadhaar details, age-proof documents, and address-proof documents, among other details. “We audited the front-end code available in public. And while auditing, [we] found that there is URL through which anyone can access Form 6 data of other voters,” said Saurav Rajput, a data scientist at Charchagram. Opening “voters.eci.gov.in/form6?refId= ” returned a web-page showing all the applicants’ details to any logged-in user, regardless of who the applicant was. “The reference IDs follow a predictable state, constituency, type and date/sequence pattern. The server did not check that the application belonged to the person asking. The predictability of the reference ID amplifies this security issue, since any user can scrape the data one by one in large volumes,” according to the report. Following the revelation, Charchagram says it reported the matter privately to the ECI and to CERT-In. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for responding to computer security incidents as and when they occur.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr. Rajput said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 was exposed on ECI citizen service portal, claims report

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:24:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While records going back to 2023 were verified for the report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For at least three years, the personal data that voters submitted to the Election Commission of India through Form 6, the application for registration as an elector, was exposed on its Citizen Service Portal (https://voters.eci.gov.in/ ) to anyone with a login, claims a report by ‘Charchagram’, a civic-tech initiative for building tools for enhancing transparency and accountability in public systems of India. It said that while records going back to 2023 were verified for this report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer. According to the report, using ECI published data, it estimates that at least seven crore Form 6 enrolments took place in this period. Each Form 6 application holds a citizen’s name, their relative’s name, gender, phone number, email, home address, photograph, Aadhaar details, age-proof documents, and address-proof documents, among other details. “We audited the front-end code available in public. And while auditing, [we] found that there is URL through which anyone can access Form 6 data of other voters,” said Saurav Rajput, a data scientist at Charchagram. Opening “voters.eci.gov.in/form6?refId= ” returned a web-page showing all the applicants’ details to any logged-in user, regardless of who the applicant was. “The reference IDs follow a predictable state, constituency, type and date/sequence pattern. The server did not check that the application belonged to the person asking. The predictability of the reference ID amplifies this security issue, since any user can scrape the data one by one in large volumes,” according to the report. Following the revelation, Charchagram says it reported the matter privately to the ECI and to CERT-In. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for responding to computer security incidents as and when they occur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr. Rajput said.

Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Acknowledgement (Adjective)
पावती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Acknowledgement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
